recipes.title: Roast French Dijon Herb Flank Steak
steps: Mix the mustard, herbs and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on a lined tray and press on the breadcrumbs mixed with butter.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with the pan juices.

recipes.title: French Au Poivre Sirloin Steak
steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and the crushed peppercorns, pressed on both sides.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the shallots and garlic for 1 minute, then the brandy (careful, it can flame), then the cream; bubble 2 minutes.
Return the sirloin steak with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the peppery cream over.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: French Dijon Cream Sirloin Steak
steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the shallots and garlic for 1 minute, then the wine and reduce by half, then the cream and mustard.
Return the sirloin steak with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Stir in the tarragon and spoon over.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: French Beurre Blanc Sirloin Steak
steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and white pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the shallots and garlic for 1 minute, then the wine and vinegar until almost gone, then whisk in the butter a cube at a time off the heat.
Return the sirloin steak with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the sauce over and scatter with chives.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: French Steak Haché Beef Patties

ingredients.name: Black pepper, coarsely crushed (or green peppercorns)

steps: Mix the beef with the egg yolk, mustard and half the shallots and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 8 patties or logs.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 8 minutes, turning, until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Cook the shallots and garlic gently in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Stir together the cream and peppercorns and bubble 2 minutes.
Spoon the sauce over and serve with fries or salad.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: Spanish Chorizo and Chickpea Beef Stew

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the smoked paprika.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the chorizo, tomatoes, chickpeas and 300 ml water, with the spinach at the end, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Drizzle with olive oil. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread or potatoes.

Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

Add the beef and the pepper and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).

recipes.title: Thai Holy Basil Pork Tenderloin Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: Basil leaves (Thai holy basil if you can find it)

steps: Slice the pork tenderloin into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the oyster sauce, fish sauce, sugar and 3 tbsp water.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the pork tenderloin in two batches, about 3 minutes per batch, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the onion with the garlic and chilies for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the pork tenderloin with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Turn off the heat and stir in the basil until it wilts.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Cashew Pork Tenderloin Stir-Fry
steps: Slice the pork tenderloin into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the oyster sauce, soy sauce, sugar and 3 tbsp water.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the pork tenderloin in two batches, about 3 minutes per batch, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the pepper and the white parts of the spring onions with the garlic and chilies for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the pork tenderloin with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Toss in the cashews and green spring onion.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Ginger Pork Tenderloin Stir-Fry

Stir-fry the ginger, onion and mushrooms with the garlic and chilies for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the pork tenderloin with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Scatter with coriander if you have it.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Massaman Pork Shoulder Curry

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, boneless, cut into 5 cm pieces

Add the coconut milk, potatoes, onion and 300 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is tender enough to pull apart.
Stir in the fish sauce, sugar and lime juice and scatter with peanuts. Taste for salt.
Serve with jasmine rice.

ingredients.name: Pork belly, skin off, cut into 4 cm cubes

steps: Pat the pork belly dry and season well with salt and the curry paste.

Lower the heat and cook the garlic and chilies for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the coconut milk, potatoes, onion and 300 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 1½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is soft and glossy.
Stir in the fish sauce, sugar and lime juice and scatter with peanuts. Taste for salt.
Serve with jasmine rice.

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, boneless, cut into 5 cm pieces

Add the coconut milk and 200 ml water, adding the pepper and beans for the last 10 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is tender enough to pull apart.
Season with the fish sauce and sugar and stir in the basil. Taste for salt.
Serve with jasmine rice.

ingredients.name: Pork belly, skin off, cut into 4 cm cubes

Season with the fish sauce and sugar and stir in the basil. Taste for salt.
Serve with jasmine rice.

Add the coconut milk, lime leaves and 200 ml water, adding the eggplant and zucchini for the last 15 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is tender enough to pull apart.
Season with the fish sauce and sugar. Taste for salt.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Green Pork Belly Curry

ingredients.name: Pork belly, skin off, cut into 4 cm cubes

steps: Pat the pork belly dry and season well with salt and the curry paste.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork belly in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and chilies for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the coconut milk, lime leaves and 200 ml water, adding the eggplant and zucchini for the last 15 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 1½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is soft and glossy.
Season with the fish sauce and sugar. Taste for salt.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Lemongrass Pork Tenderloin Traybake
steps: Mix the lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce, sugar and soy sauce with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the pork tenderloin and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 220 °C (200 °C fan). Spread on a lined tray in one layer.
Roast for about 20 minutes, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre.
Rest 5 minutes. Scatter with coriander and serve with lime wedges.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Lemongrass Pork Chops Traybake

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

steps: Mix the lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce, sugar and soy sauce with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the pork chops and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill in one layer.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre.
Rest 5 minutes. Scatter with coriander and serve with lime wedges.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Grilled Thai Gai Yang-Style Pork Tenderloin
steps: Mix the fish sauce, soy sauce, sugar, coriander, pepper and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the pork tenderloin and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 220 °C (200 °C fan). Spread on a rack over a lined tray.
Roast for about 20 minutes, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre.
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with sweet chili sauce for dipping.

recipes.title: Grilled Thai Gai Yang-Style Pork Chops

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

steps: Mix the fish sauce, soy sauce, sugar, coriander, pepper and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the pork chops and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Spread on a rack over a lined tray.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre.
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with sweet chili sauce for dipping.

recipes.title: Thai Garlic Pepper Pork Chops

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

steps: Pat the pork chops dry and season with salt and the white pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 4 to 5 minutes per side, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and chilies for 1 minute, then the garlic for 1 minute, then add the oyster sauce, fish sauce, sugar and 4 tbsp water.
Return the pork chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the glossy garlic sauce over.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Larb Pork Lettuce Cups
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the garlic and chilies for 5 minutes.
Add the pork and the garlic and chilies and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the lime juice and fish sauce.
Toss with the onion, mint and toasted rice powder and spoon into lettuce leaves.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Basil Pork Stir-Fry
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the garlic and chilies for 5 minutes.
Add the pork and the garlic and chilies and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the oyster sauce, fish sauce, sugar and 3 tbsp water.
Stir in the basil and serve each portion topped with a fried egg.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Black Bean Pork Tenderloin Stir-Fry
steps: Slice the pork tenderloin into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the black bean sauce, soy sauce, sugar and 4 tbsp water.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the pork tenderloin in two batches, about 3 minutes per batch, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the pepper and onion with the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the pork tenderloin with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Scatter with the green spring onions.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Kung Pao Pork Tenderloin Stir-Fry
steps: Slice the pork tenderloin into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, cornstarch and 3 tbsp water.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the pork tenderloin in two batches, about 3 minutes per batch, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the dried chilies and Sichuan pepper for 30 seconds, then with the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the pork tenderloin with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Toss in the peanuts and green spring onions.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Broccoli and Oyster Sauce Pork Tenderloin Stir-Fry
steps: Slice the pork tenderloin into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the oyster sauce, soy sauce and 3 tbsp water.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the pork tenderloin in two batches, about 3 minutes per batch, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the broccoli with 3 tbsp water (cover 2 minutes to steam) and with the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the pork tenderloin with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Finish with the sesame oil.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Sweet and Sour Pork Tenderloin Stir-Fry
steps: Slice the pork tenderloin into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the ketchup, vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, cornstarch and 4 tbsp water.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the pork tenderloin in two batches, about 3 minutes per batch, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the pepper, onion and pineapple with the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the pork tenderloin with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Toss until everything is coated in the bright sauce.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Red-Braised Pork Shoulder Hong Shao

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, boneless, cut into 5 cm pieces
Soy sauce (1 tbsp dark if you have it)

steps: Pat the pork shoulder dry and season well with salt and the star anise and cinnamon.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork shoulder in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the soy sauces, wine, sugar and water to just cover, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is tender enough to pull apart.
Uncover for the last 15 minutes and boil until the sauce is sticky. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Red-Braised Pork Belly Hong Shao

ingredients.name: Pork belly, skin off, cut into 4 cm cubes
Soy sauce (1 tbsp dark if you have it)

steps: Pat the pork belly dry and season well with salt and the star anise and cinnamon.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork belly in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the soy sauces, wine, sugar and water to just cover, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 1½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is soft and glossy.
Uncover for the last 15 minutes and boil until the sauce is sticky. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Five-Spice Braised Pork Shoulder

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, boneless, cut into 5 cm pieces

steps: Pat the pork shoulder dry and season well with salt and the five-spice.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork shoulder in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the soy sauce, hoisin, wine, carrots and 400 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is tender enough to pull apart.
Reduce the sauce until it coats the meat. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Five-Spice Braised Pork Belly

ingredients.name: Pork belly, skin off, cut into 4 cm cubes

Serve with steamed rice.

Roast for about 20 minutes, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre.
Rest 5 minutes. Slice and spoon over the pan juices.
Serve with steamed rice.

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

steps: Mix the hoisin, honey, soy sauce, five-spice, wine and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the pork chops and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 8 hours in the fridge.

steps: Mix the soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, ginger and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the pork tenderloin and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 220 °C (200 °C fan). Spread on a lined tray.
Roast for about 20 minutes, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre.
Rest 5 minutes. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and the green spring onions.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Honey Soy Pork Chops Traybake

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

steps: Mix the soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, ginger and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the pork chops and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre.

Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Ginger Scallion Pork Chops

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

steps: Pat the pork chops dry and season with salt and white pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 4 to 5 minutes per side, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre. Rest on a warm plate.

Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 1 minute, then the ginger and spring onions for 1 minute, then add the soy sauce, wine and 4 tbsp water.
Return the pork chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Drizzle with the sesame oil.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Mapo-Style Pork Tofu
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 5 minutes.
Add the pork and the chili bean paste and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the stock, soy sauce and tofu; simmer 5 minutes, then thicken with the cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water.
Sprinkle with the ground Sichuan pepper and green spring onions.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Lion's Head Pork Meatballs
steps: Mix the pork with the egg, soy sauce, wine, cornstarch, ginger and spring onion whites and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 16 balls.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 6 minutes, turning; they finish cooking in the sauce.
Cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions gently in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Add the stock and cabbage; cover and simmer 20 minutes, until the meat is no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Serve the meatballs in bowls with the cabbage and broth.

recipes.title: Sichuan Cumin Pork Tenderloin Stir-Fry
steps: Slice the pork tenderloin into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the soy sauce and 2 tbsp water.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the pork tenderloin in two batches, about 3 minutes per batch, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the cumin, chili flakes and onion with the garlic and ginger for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the pork tenderloin with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Toss in the coriander.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Sichuan Dry-Fried Pork Tenderloin Stir-Fry
steps: Slice the pork tenderloin into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the soy sauce and sugar.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the pork tenderloin in two batches, about 3 minutes per batch, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the green beans for 5 minutes until blistered, then the chilies and Sichuan pepper, then with the garlic and ginger for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the pork tenderloin with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Serve right away while the beans are crisp.

recipes.title: Sichuan Fish-Fragrant Pork Tenderloin Stir-Fry
steps: Slice the pork tenderloin into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the pork tenderloin in two batches, about 3 minutes per batch, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the eggplant until soft, then with the garlic and ginger for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the pork tenderloin with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Toss until glossy.
Serve with steamed rice.

Add the soy sauce, daikon and water to just cover, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is tender enough to pull apart.
Scatter with Sichuan pepper and coriander. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Sichuan Spicy Bean Paste Braised Pork Belly

steps: Pat the pork belly dry and season well with salt and the chili bean paste and star anise.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork belly in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and ginger for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the soy sauce, daikon and water to just cover, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 1½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is soft and glossy.
Scatter with Sichuan pepper and coriander. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Sichuan Mala Pork Chops

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

steps: Pat the pork chops dry and season with salt and the ground Sichuan pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 4 to 5 minutes per side, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the chili oil, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and 3 tbsp water.
Return the pork chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the numbing chili sauce over.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Sichuan Dan Dan-Style Pork Noodles
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the garlic and ginger for 5 minutes.
Add the pork and the ginger and garlic and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the soy sauce and fry until the meat is crisp.
Divide the sesame paste, chili oil and Sichuan pepper between bowls, add the boiled noodles and bok choy and top with the crispy meat.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Ginger Pork Tenderloin Shogayaki
steps: Slice the pork tenderloin into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the soy sauce, mirin, sake and grated ginger.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the pork tenderloin in two batches, about 3 minutes per batch, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the onion with the garlic and ginger for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the pork tenderloin with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Serve with the raw shredded cabbage.

recipes.title: Japanese Yakisoba Pork Tenderloin Noodles
steps: Slice the pork tenderloin into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the Worcestershire sauce, oyster sauce and ketchup.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the pork tenderloin in two batches, about 3 minutes per batch, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the cabbage and carrot, then the noodles with the garlic and ginger for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the pork tenderloin with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Toss everything together until hot.
Serve with steamed short-grain rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Nikujaga-Style Pork Shoulder Stew

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, boneless, cut into 5 cm pieces

steps: Pat the pork shoulder dry and season well with salt and the onion.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork shoulder in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and ginger for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the dashi, soy sauce, mirin, sugar, potatoes and carrots, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is tender enough to pull apart.
Let it sit 10 minutes so the potatoes soak up the sauce. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed short-grain rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Nikujaga-Style Pork Belly Stew

Serve over rice. Taste for salt.

Serve over rice. Taste for salt.

Yuzu kosho (or lemon zest and green chili)

recipes.title: Japanese Teriyaki Pork Chops

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

steps: Pat the pork chops dry and season with salt and a pinch of salt only (the sauce is salty).
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 4 to 5 minutes per side, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the soy sauce, mirin, sake and sugar and let it bubble 2 minutes until syrupy.
Return the pork chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Turn to coat and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve with steamed short-grain rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Butter Ponzu Pork Chops

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick
Ponzu (or soy sauce with lemon juice)

steps: Pat the pork chops dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 4 to 5 minutes per side, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the ponzu and butter and swirl until glossy.
Return the pork chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Scatter with the spring onions.
Serve with steamed short-grain rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Tsukune-Style Pork Patties
steps: Mix the pork with the egg, panko, spring onions, ginger and a pinch of salt and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 8 patties or logs.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 8 minutes, turning, until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir together the soy sauce, mirin and sugar and bubble until it coats the patties.
Serve glazed, with rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Soboro Pork Rice Bowls
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the garlic and ginger for 5 minutes.
Add the pork and the ginger and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the soy sauce, mirin and sugar and cook until dry and crumbly.
Scramble the eggs into fine curds separately, then top bowls of rice with the meat, egg and peas.
Serve with steamed short-grain rice.

recipes.title: Korean Bulgogi-Style Pork Tenderloin Stir-Fry
steps: Slice the pork tenderloin into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the soy sauce, sugar, grated pear and sesame oil.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the pork tenderloin in two batches, about 3 minutes per batch, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the onion with the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the pork tenderloin with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and the green spring onions.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Korean Spicy Gochujang Pork Tenderloin Stir-Fry
steps: Slice the pork tenderloin into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the gochujang, chili flakes, soy sauce, sugar and sesame oil.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the pork tenderloin in two batches, about 3 minutes per batch, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the onion and cabbage with the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the pork tenderloin with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Scatter with the green spring onions.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Korean Japchae Pork Tenderloin Noodles
steps: Slice the pork tenderloin into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the soy sauce, sugar and sesame oil.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the pork tenderloin in two batches, about 3 minutes per batch, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the carrot and mushrooms, then the spinach, then the cooked noodles with the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the pork tenderloin with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Toss well and serve warm or at room temperature.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Korean Galbi Jjim-Style Braised Pork Shoulder

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, boneless, cut into 5 cm pieces

steps: Pat the pork shoulder dry and season well with salt and black pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork shoulder in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the soy sauce, sugar, grated pear, mushrooms and water to just cover, adding the carrot and daikon for the last 40 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is tender enough to pull apart.
Reduce the sauce until glossy and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Korean Galbi Jjim-Style Braised Pork Belly

ingredients.name: Pork belly, skin off, cut into 4 cm cubes

steps: Pat the pork belly dry and season well with salt and black pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork belly in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the soy sauce, sugar, grated pear, mushrooms and water to just cover, adding the carrot and daikon for the last 40 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 1½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is soft and glossy.
Reduce the sauce until glossy and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Korean Dakdoritang-Style Pork Shoulder Stew

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, boneless, cut into 5 cm pieces

steps: Pat the pork shoulder dry and season well with salt and the gochujang and chili flakes.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork shoulder in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the soy sauce, sugar, potatoes, carrots, onion and 600 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is tender enough to pull apart.
Scatter with the green spring onions. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Korean Dakdoritang-Style Pork Belly Stew

ingredients.name: Pork belly, skin off, cut into 4 cm cubes

steps: Pat the pork belly dry and season well with salt and the gochujang and chili flakes.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork belly in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the soy sauce, sugar, potatoes, carrots, onion and 600 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 1½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is soft and glossy.
Scatter with the green spring onions. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Korean Gochujang Pork Tenderloin Traybake
steps: Mix the gochujang, honey, soy sauce, sesame oil, vinegar and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the pork tenderloin and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 220 °C (200 °C fan). Spread on a lined tray and turn once.
Roast for about 20 minutes, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre.
Rest 5 minutes. Sprinkle with the green spring onions and serve with lettuce leaves for wrapping.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Korean Gochujang Pork Chops Traybake

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

steps: Mix the gochujang, honey, soy sauce, sesame oil, vinegar and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the pork chops and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill and turn once.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre.
Rest 5 minutes. Sprinkle with the green spring onions and serve with lettuce leaves for wrapping.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Grilled Korean Galbi-Style Pork Tenderloin
steps: Mix the soy sauce, sugar, grated pear, sesame oil and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the pork tenderloin and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 220 °C (200 °C fan). Lay on a rack over a lined tray.
Roast for about 20 minutes, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre.
Rest 5 minutes. Sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Grilled Korean Galbi-Style Pork Chops

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

steps: Mix the soy sauce, sugar, grated pear, sesame oil and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the pork chops and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre.
Rest 5 minutes. Sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Korean Soy Garlic Pork Chops

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

steps: Pat the pork chops dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 4 to 5 minutes per side, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre. Rest on a warm plate.

Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 1 minute, then the garlic for 1 minute, then add the soy sauce, honey, vinegar and chili flakes and bubble until sticky.
Return the pork chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Turn to coat.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Korean Gochujang Pork Rice Bowls
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 5 minutes.
Add the pork and the garlic and ginger and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the gochujang, soy sauce, sugar and sesame oil.
Spoon over rice with the cucumber, spinach and a fried egg.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Lemongrass Pork Tenderloin Stir-Fry
steps: Slice the pork tenderloin into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the fish sauce, sugar and 2 tbsp water.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the pork tenderloin in two batches, about 3 minutes per batch, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the lemongrass, chili and onion with the garlic and shallots for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the pork tenderloin with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Top with the coriander.
Serve with rice or rice noodles with herbs.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Shaking Pork Tenderloin Bo Luc Lac-Style
steps: Slice the pork tenderloin into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce and sugar.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the pork tenderloin in two batches, about 3 minutes per batch, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the onion with the garlic and shallots for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the pork tenderloin with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Serve on the watercress and tomatoes.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Caramel Pork Shoulder Kho

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, boneless, cut into 5 cm pieces

steps: Pat the pork shoulder dry and season well with salt and the sugar, cooked dry in the pot until dark amber, then.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork shoulder in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and shallots for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the fish sauce, coconut water, pepper and eggs, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is tender enough to pull apart.
Reduce until the sauce is dark and sticky. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice or rice noodles with herbs.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Caramel Pork Belly Kho

ingredients.name: Pork belly, skin off, cut into 4 cm cubes

steps: Pat the pork belly dry and season well with salt and the sugar, cooked dry in the pot until dark amber, then.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork belly in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and shallots for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the fish sauce, coconut water, pepper and eggs, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 1½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is soft and glossy.
Reduce until the sauce is dark and sticky. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice or rice noodles with herbs.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Lemongrass Pork Shoulder Stew

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, boneless, cut into 5 cm pieces

steps: Pat the pork shoulder dry and season well with salt and the curry powder and lemongrass.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork shoulder in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and shallots for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the coconut milk, fish sauce, carrots, sweet potato and 300 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is tender enough to pull apart.
Serve with bread or rice noodles. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Lemongrass Pork Belly Stew

ingredients.name: Pork belly, skin off, cut into 4 cm cubes

steps: Pat the pork belly dry and season well with salt and the curry powder and lemongrass.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork belly in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and shallots for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the coconut milk, fish sauce, carrots, sweet potato and 300 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 1½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is soft and glossy.
Serve with bread or rice noodles. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Grilled Vietnamese Lemongrass Pork Tenderloin
steps: Mix the lemongrass, garlic, shallots, fish sauce and sugar with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the pork tenderloin and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 220 °C (200 °C fan). Lay on a rack over a lined tray.
Roast for about 20 minutes, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre.
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with mint and lime wedges.

recipes.title: Grilled Vietnamese Lemongrass Pork Chops

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

steps: Mix the lemongrass, garlic, shallots, fish sauce and sugar with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the pork chops and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre.
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with mint and lime wedges.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Nuoc Cham Pork Chops

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

steps: Pat the pork chops dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 4 to 5 minutes per side, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and shallots for 1 minute, then the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the fish sauce, sugar, lime juice, chili and 3 tbsp water.
Return the pork chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon over and scatter with mint.
Serve with rice or rice noodles with herbs.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Bun Cha-Style Pork Patties
steps: Mix the pork with half the fish sauce, half the sugar, the garlic and shallots and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 8 patties or logs.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 8 minutes, turning, until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Cook the garlic and shallots gently in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Stir together the rest of the fish sauce and sugar with the lime juice and 150 ml warm water as a dipping sauce.
Serve with the noodles, lettuce and herbs, dipping into the sauce.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Black Pork Shoulder Curry

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, boneless, cut into 5 cm pieces

steps: Pat the pork shoulder dry and season well with salt and the curry powder, pepper and cinnamon.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork shoulder in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion, garlic, ginger and curry leaves for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the tamarind and 400 ml water, then the coconut milk for the last 20 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is tender enough to pull apart.
Simmer until dark and thick. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Black Pork Belly Curry

ingredients.name: Pork belly, skin off, cut into 4 cm cubes

steps: Pat the pork belly dry and season well with salt and the curry powder, pepper and cinnamon.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork belly in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion, garlic, ginger and curry leaves for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the tamarind and 400 ml water, then the coconut milk for the last 20 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 1½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is soft and glossy.
Simmer until dark and thick. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Coconut Pork Shoulder Curry

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, boneless, cut into 5 cm pieces

steps: Pat the pork shoulder dry and season well with salt and the curry powder, turmeric and chili.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork shoulder in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion, garlic, ginger and curry leaves for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the coconut milk and 200 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is tender enough to pull apart.
Finish with the lime juice. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Coconut Pork Belly Curry

ingredients.name: Pork belly, skin off, cut into 4 cm cubes

steps: Pat the pork belly dry and season well with salt and the curry powder, turmeric and chili.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork belly in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion, garlic, ginger and curry leaves for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the coconut milk and 200 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 1½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is soft and glossy.
Finish with the lime juice. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Devilled Pork Chops

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

steps: Pat the pork chops dry and season with salt and the chili flakes.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 4 to 5 minutes per side, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion, garlic, ginger and curry leaves for 1 minute, then the onion and pepper for 3 minutes, then the ketchup, chili sauce, soy sauce and 3 tbsp water.
Return the pork chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Toss to coat.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Filipino Adobo Braised Pork Shoulder

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, boneless, cut into 5 cm pieces

steps: Pat the pork shoulder dry and season well with salt and the peppercorns and bay leaves.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork shoulder in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and 200 ml water; let it boil 2 minutes before stirring so the vinegar mellows, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is tender enough to pull apart.
Reduce the sauce until it coats the meat. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Filipino Adobo Braised Pork Belly

ingredients.name: Pork belly, skin off, cut into 4 cm cubes

steps: Pat the pork belly dry and season well with salt and the peppercorns and bay leaves.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork belly in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and 200 ml water; let it boil 2 minutes before stirring so the vinegar mellows, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 1½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is soft and glossy.
Reduce the sauce until it coats the meat. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Filipino Caldereta-Style Pork Shoulder Stew

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, boneless, cut into 5 cm pieces

steps: Pat the pork shoulder dry and season well with salt and black pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork shoulder in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the tomato sauce and 300 ml water, adding the potatoes and carrots for the last 30 minutes and the pepper for the last 10, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is tender enough to pull apart.
Stir in the pate and olives. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Filipino Caldereta-Style Pork Belly Stew

ingredients.name: Pork belly, skin off, cut into 4 cm cubes

steps: Pat the pork belly dry and season well with salt and black pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork belly in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the tomato sauce and 300 ml water, adding the potatoes and carrots for the last 30 minutes and the pepper for the last 10, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 1½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is soft and glossy.
Stir in the pate and olives. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Filipino Sinigang-Style Pork Shoulder Sour Soup

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, boneless, cut into 5 cm pieces

steps: Pat the pork shoulder dry and season well with salt and black pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork shoulder in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add 1.5 litres water, the tamarind and tomatoes, adding the radish and beans for the last 10 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is tender enough to pull apart.
Stir in the spinach and fish sauce. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Filipino Sinigang-Style Pork Belly Sour Soup

ingredients.name: Pork belly, skin off, cut into 4 cm cubes

steps: Pat the pork belly dry and season well with salt and black pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork belly in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add 1.5 litres water, the tamarind and tomatoes, adding the radish and beans for the last 10 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 1½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is soft and glossy.
Stir in the spinach and fish sauce. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Grilled Filipino Inasal-Style Pork Tenderloin
steps: Mix the lemongrass, vinegar, citrus juice, annatto and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the pork tenderloin and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 220 °C (200 °C fan). Lay on a rack over a lined tray, basting with the butter.
Roast for about 20 minutes, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre.
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with soy-vinegar dip.

recipes.title: Grilled Filipino Inasal-Style Pork Chops

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

steps: Mix the lemongrass, vinegar, citrus juice, annatto and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the pork chops and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill, basting with the butter.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre.
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with soy-vinegar dip.

recipes.title: Filipino Bistek-Style Pork Chops

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

steps: Pat the pork chops dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 4 to 5 minutes per side, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the onion rings for 3 minutes, then the soy sauce, lemon juice and 4 tbsp water.
Return the pork chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the onions and sauce over.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Mexican Chipotle Pork Shoulder Tinga

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, boneless, cut into 5 cm pieces

steps: Pat the pork shoulder dry and season well with salt and the cumin and oregano.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork shoulder in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the tomatoes, chipotles and 200 ml water; shred the meat at the end, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is tender enough to pull apart.
Serve in tortillas with avocado and crema. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Mexican Chipotle Pork Belly Tinga

ingredients.name: Pork belly, skin off, cut into 4 cm cubes

steps: Pat the pork belly dry and season well with salt and the cumin and oregano.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork belly in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the tomatoes, chipotles and 200 ml water; shred the meat at the end, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 1½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is soft and glossy.
Serve in tortillas with avocado and crema. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Mexican Red Chile Pork Shoulder Guisado

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, boneless, cut into 5 cm pieces
Dried guajillo chilies, seeded and soaked
Dried ancho chilies, seeded and soaked

steps: Pat the pork shoulder dry and season well with salt and the cumin and oregano.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork shoulder in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the chilies blended with the stock, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is tender enough to pull apart.
Serve with rice and beans. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Mexican Red Chile Pork Belly Guisado

ingredients.name: Pork belly, skin off, cut into 4 cm cubes
Dried guajillo chilies, seeded and soaked
Dried ancho chilies, seeded and soaked

steps: Pat the pork belly dry and season well with salt and the cumin and oregano.

Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre.
Rest 5 minutes. Slice thinly and serve in tortillas with salsa.

Serve with warm tortillas and rice.

recipes.title: Mexican Fajita Pork Chops

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

steps: Pat the pork chops dry and season with salt and the chili powder, cumin and paprika.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 4 to 5 minutes per side, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the peppers and onion until charred at the edges, then a splash of water.
Return the pork chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Slice the meat, squeeze over the lime and pile into tortillas.
Serve with warm tortillas and rice.

recipes.title: Mexican Mole-Style Pork Chops

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

steps: Pat the pork chops dry and season with salt and ground cumin.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 4 to 5 minutes per side, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the mole paste and stock and simmer until thick, then melt in the chocolate.
Return the pork chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the sauce over and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve with warm tortillas and rice.

recipes.title: Mexican Picadillo Pork Mince
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the onion and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the pork and the cumin and oregano and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the tomatoes, potatoes, carrots and 150 ml water; simmer 15 minutes until tender.
Serve with rice or in tortillas.

recipes.title: Mexican Albondigas Pork Meatballs
steps: Mix the pork with the egg, rice, mint and half the garlic and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 16 balls.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 6 minutes, turning; they finish cooking in the sauce.
Cook the onion and garlic gently in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes blended with the chipotle, then the stock; simmer the meatballs 25 minutes, until the meat is no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Serve as a soupy stew.

Add the tomatoes, beans and stock, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is tender enough to pull apart.
Serve with cheese and sour cream. Taste for salt.

Add the pork and the chili powder, cumin and paprika and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the tomato sauce and 100 ml water and simmer until thick.
Fill the taco shells with the meat, lettuce and cheese.
Serve with rice and beans.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Enchilada Pork Bake

Add the pork and the chili powder and cumin and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in half the sauce and the beans.
Roll the filling in tortillas, cover with the rest of the sauce and cheese and bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes.
Serve with rice and beans.

Stir-fry the onion wedges and chili with the onion and garlic for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the pork tenderloin with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Toss with the hot fries.

Rest 5 minutes. Slice and serve with the salsa.
Serve with rice and black beans.

recipes.title: Brazilian Acebolado Pork Chops

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

steps: Pat the pork chops dry and season with salt and the paprika.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 4 to 5 minutes per side, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the onion rings in the butter until soft and golden, then the vinegar.
Return the pork chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Pile the onions on top.
Serve with rice and black beans.

recipes.title: Grilled Argentine Chimichurri Pork Tenderloin
steps: Mix salt, a little of the oregano and the oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the pork tenderloin and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 220 °C (200 °C fan). Mix the parsley, garlic, the rest of the oregano, chili, vinegar and oil as chimichurri.
Roast for about 20 minutes, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre.
Rest 5 minutes. Slice and spoon over the chimichurri.
Serve with roast potatoes or a green salad.

recipes.title: Grilled Argentine Chimichurri Pork Chops

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

steps: Mix salt, a little of the oregano and the oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the pork chops and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Mix the parsley, garlic, the rest of the oregano, chili, vinegar and oil as chimichurri.

recipes.title: Argentine Salsa Criolla Pork Chops

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 4 to 5 minutes per side, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre. Rest on a warm plate.
Meanwhile, off the heat, mix the onion, pepper, tomatoes, vinegar and oil for the salsa while the meat rests.
Spoon the salsa over.
Serve with roast potatoes or a green salad.

recipes.title: Argentine Carbonada-Style Pork Shoulder Stew

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, boneless, cut into 5 cm pieces

steps: Pat the pork shoulder dry and season well with salt and paprika.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork shoulder in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the tomatoes and stock, adding the vegetables and fruit for the last 30 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is tender enough to pull apart.
Serve in bowls. Taste for salt.

steps: Mix the fennel seeds, rosemary, lemon zest, chili and garlic with oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the pork tenderloin and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 220 °C (200 °C fan). Lay in a roasting dish and pour the wine around.
Roast for about 20 minutes, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre.
Rest 5 minutes. Slice and spoon over the pan juices.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 4 to 5 minutes per side, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the stock, lemon juice and capers and bubble 2 minutes, then swirl in the butter.
Return the pork chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Scatter with parsley.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

Return the pork chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the mushrooms and sauce over.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Saltimbocca-Style Pork Chops

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

steps: Pat the pork chops dry and season with salt and black pepper; lay a sage leaf and a slice of prosciutto on each piece and press.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 4 to 5 minutes per side, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre. Rest on a warm plate.

Return the pork chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the buttery sauce over.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Polpette Pork Meatballs
steps: Mix the pork with the egg, breadcrumbs, parmesan, parsley and half the garlic and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 16 balls.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 6 minutes, turning; they finish cooking in the sauce.
Cook the onion and garlic gently in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Add the passata and simmer the meatballs gently for 20 minutes, until the meat is no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Tear over the basil and serve with bread or pasta.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Bolognese-Style Pork Ragù
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the onion and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the pork and the carrot and celery and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the wine, then the passata; simmer 30 minutes.
Toss with the pasta and parmesan.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: French Coq au Vin-Style Braised Pork Shoulder

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, boneless, cut into 5 cm pieces

steps: Pat the pork shoulder dry and season well with salt and the thyme and flour.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork shoulder in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the shallots and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the wine, bay leaves and 250 ml stock or water; fry the bacon, mushrooms and onions separately and add for the last 20 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is tender enough to pull apart.
Scatter with parsley. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: Roast French Dijon Herb Pork Tenderloin

Heat the oven to 220 °C (200 °C fan). Lay on a lined tray and press on the breadcrumbs mixed with butter.
Roast for about 20 minutes, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre.
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with the pan juices.

Spoon the sauce over and serve with fries or salad.

Serve with crusty bread or potatoes.

recipes.title: Roast Portuguese Piri-Piri Pork Tenderloin
steps: Mix the chilies, paprika, lemon, vinegar, oregano and garlic blended with oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the pork tenderloin and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 220 °C (200 °C fan). Lay on a rack over a lined tray.
Roast for about 20 minutes, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre.
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with fries or rice.

recipes.title: Roast Portuguese Piri-Piri Pork Chops

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

steps: Mix the chilies, paprika, lemon, vinegar, oregano and garlic blended with oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the pork chops and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre.
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with fries or rice.

recipes.title: Portuguese Alentejana-Style Braised Pork Shoulder

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, boneless, cut into 5 cm pieces

steps: Pat the pork shoulder dry and season well with salt and the paprika.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork shoulder in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the wine and bay leaves; add the clams for the last 5 minutes until they open, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is tender enough to pull apart.
Scatter with coriander. Taste for salt.
Serve with potatoes or rice.

recipes.title: Portuguese Alentejana-Style Braised Pork Belly

ingredients.name: Pork belly, skin off, cut into 4 cm cubes

steps: Pat the pork belly dry and season well with salt and the paprika.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork belly in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the wine and bay leaves; add the clams for the last 5 minutes until they open, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 1½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is soft and glossy.
Scatter with coriander. Taste for salt.
Serve with potatoes or rice.

recipes.title: Portuguese Garlic Wine Pork Chops Bitoque-Style

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

steps: Pat the pork chops dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 4 to 5 minutes per side, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the garlic and bay leaves, then the wine; bubble 2 minutes.
Return the pork chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Serve each portion topped with a fried egg.

recipes.title: Greek Stifado Pork Shoulder Stew

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, boneless, cut into 5 cm pieces

steps: Pat the pork shoulder dry and season well with salt and the cinnamon and cloves.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork shoulder in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the wine, vinegar, tomatoes, bay leaves and whole shallots, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is tender enough to pull apart.
Serve with rice or orzo. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Greek Stifado Pork Belly Stew

ingredients.name: Pork belly, skin off, cut into 4 cm cubes

steps: Pat the pork belly dry and season well with salt and the cinnamon and cloves.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork belly in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the wine, vinegar, tomatoes, bay leaves and whole shallots, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 1½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is soft and glossy.
Serve with rice or orzo. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Greek Lemon Oregano Pork Shoulder Lemonato

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, boneless, cut into 5 cm pieces

steps: Pat the pork shoulder dry and season well with salt and the oregano.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork shoulder in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the lemon juice, stock and potatoes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is tender enough to pull apart.
Simmer uncovered until the sauce is reduced and lemony. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice, potatoes or warm pitta.

recipes.title: Greek Lemon Oregano Pork Belly Lemonato

ingredients.name: Pork belly, skin off, cut into 4 cm cubes

steps: Pat the pork belly dry and season well with salt and the oregano.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork belly in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the lemon juice, stock and potatoes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 1½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is soft and glossy.
Simmer uncovered until the sauce is reduced and lemony. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice, potatoes or warm pitta.

recipes.title: Greek Souvlaki Pork Tenderloin Skewers
steps: Mix the lemon juice, oregano, garlic and oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the pork tenderloin and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 220 °C (200 °C fan). Thread on skewers and lay on a lined tray; mix the yogurt and squeezed cucumber as tzatziki.
Roast for about 20 minutes, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre.
Rest 5 minutes. Serve in warm pitta with the tzatziki.

recipes.title: Greek Souvlaki Pork Chops Skewers

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

steps: Mix the lemon juice, oregano, garlic and oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the pork chops and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Thread on skewers and cook on the grill; mix the yogurt and squeezed cucumber as tzatziki.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre.
Rest 5 minutes. Serve in warm pitta with the tzatziki.

recipes.title: Greek Feta and Tomato Pork Chops

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

steps: Pat the pork chops dry and season with salt and the oregano.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 4 to 5 minutes per side, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the cherry tomatoes until they burst, then the olives.
Return the pork chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Crumble over the feta.
Serve with rice, potatoes or warm pitta.

recipes.title: Greek Keftedes Pork Meatballs
steps: Mix the pork with the egg, breadcrumbs, mint, oregano, onion and garlic and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 16 balls.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 8 minutes, turning, until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir together the yogurt seasoned with salt and a little garlic as a dip.
Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: American Pot Roast-Style Braised Pork Shoulder

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, boneless, cut into 5 cm pieces

steps: Pat the pork shoulder dry and season well with salt and the thyme and tomato paste.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork shoulder in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the stock, with the carrots and potatoes for the last hour, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is tender enough to pull apart.
Thicken the gravy if you like and serve. Taste for salt.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: American Pot Roast-Style Braised Pork Belly

ingredients.name: Pork belly, skin off, cut into 4 cm cubes

steps: Pat the pork belly dry and season well with salt and the thyme and tomato paste.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork belly in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the stock, with the carrots and potatoes for the last hour, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 1½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is soft and glossy.
Thicken the gravy if you like and serve. Taste for salt.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: American BBQ Pork Tenderloin Traybake
steps: Mix the paprika, sugar, garlic powder and half the sauce with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the pork tenderloin and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 220 °C (200 °C fan). Spread on a lined tray, brushing with the rest of the sauce for the last 10 minutes.
Roast for about 20 minutes, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre.
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with coleslaw.

recipes.title: American BBQ Pork Chops Traybake

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

steps: Mix the paprika, sugar, garlic powder and half the sauce with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the pork chops and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill, brushing with the rest of the sauce for the last 10 minutes.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre.
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with coleslaw.

recipes.title: Roast American Maple Mustard Pork Tenderloin
steps: Mix the maple, mustard, vinegar and rosemary with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the pork tenderloin and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 220 °C (200 °C fan). Lay on a lined tray.
Roast for about 20 minutes, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre.
Rest 5 minutes. Spoon over the pan juices.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: Roast American Maple Mustard Pork Chops

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

steps: Mix the maple, mustard, vinegar and rosemary with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the pork chops and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on a lined tray.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre.
Rest 5 minutes. Spoon over the pan juices.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: American Honey Garlic Pork Chops

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

steps: Pat the pork chops dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 4 to 5 minutes per side, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the garlic for 30 seconds, then the honey, soy sauce and vinegar; bubble until sticky.
Return the pork chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Turn to coat.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: American Creamy Tuscan-Style Pork Chops

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

steps: Pat the pork chops dry and season with salt and the Italian seasoning.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 4 to 5 minutes per side, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the sun-dried tomatoes and garlic, then the cream and parmesan, then the spinach until wilted.
Return the pork chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon over.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: American Sloppy Joe-Style Pork Sandwiches
