steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the onion and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the pork and the pepper and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, sugar and 100 ml water and simmer 10 minutes.
Pile onto toasted buns.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: British Ale Pork Shoulder Stew

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, boneless, cut into 5 cm pieces

steps: Pat the pork shoulder dry and season well with salt and the flour and thyme.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork shoulder in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the ale, Worcestershire sauce, bay leaves, carrots and 200 ml stock, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is tender enough to pull apart.
Serve with mash or crusty bread. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: British Ale Pork Belly Stew

ingredients.name: Pork belly, skin off, cut into 4 cm cubes

steps: Pat the pork belly dry and season well with salt and the flour and thyme.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork belly in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the ale, Worcestershire sauce, bay leaves, carrots and 200 ml stock, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 1½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the pork is soft and glossy.
Serve with mash or crusty bread. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: British Honey Mustard Pork Tenderloin Traybake
steps: Mix the mustard, honey, thyme and oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the pork tenderloin and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 220 °C (200 °C fan). Spread on a tray with the potatoes and parsnips (start the vegetables 15 minutes earlier).
Roast for about 20 minutes, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre.
Rest 5 minutes. Spoon over the sticky juices.
Serve with mashed potatoes and greens.

recipes.title: British Honey Mustard Pork Chops Traybake

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

steps: Mix the mustard, honey, thyme and oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the pork chops and leave to marinate 30 minutes or up to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Spread on a tray with the potatoes and parsnips (start the vegetables 15 minutes earlier).
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre.
Rest 5 minutes. Spoon over the sticky juices.
Serve with mashed potatoes and greens.

recipes.title: British Peppercorn Pork Chops

ingredients.name: Pork chops, boneless, about 2 cm thick

steps: Pat the pork chops dry and season with salt and the crushed peppercorns.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 4 to 5 minutes per side, until 63 °C (145 °F) in the centre. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the cream and mustard; bubble 2 minutes.
Return the pork chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon over and serve with chips or salad.
Serve with mashed potatoes and greens.

recipes.title: Thai Massaman Lamb Curry

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the curry paste.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and chilies for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the coconut milk, potatoes, onion and 300 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Stir in the fish sauce, sugar and lime juice and scatter with peanuts. Taste for salt.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Red Lamb Curry

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the curry paste.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and chilies for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the coconut milk and 200 ml water, adding the pepper and beans for the last 10 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Season with the fish sauce and sugar and stir in the basil. Taste for salt.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Green Lamb Curry

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the curry paste.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and chilies for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the coconut milk, lime leaves and 200 ml water, adding the eggplant and zucchini for the last 15 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Season with the fish sauce and sugar. Taste for salt.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Lemongrass Lamb Chops Traybake
steps: Mix the lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce, sugar and soy sauce with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill in one layer.
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Scatter with coriander and serve with lime wedges.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Grilled Thai Gai Yang-Style Lamb Chops
steps: Mix the fish sauce, soy sauce, sugar, coriander, pepper and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Spread on a rack over a lined tray.
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with sweet chili sauce for dipping.

recipes.title: Thai Garlic Pepper Lamb Chops
steps: Pat the lamb chops dry and season with salt and the white pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and chilies for 1 minute, then the garlic for 1 minute, then add the oyster sauce, fish sauce, sugar and 4 tbsp water.
Return the lamb chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the glossy garlic sauce over.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Larb Lamb Lettuce Cups
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the garlic and chilies for 5 minutes.
Add the lamb and the garlic and chilies and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the lime juice and fish sauce.
Toss with the onion, mint and toasted rice powder and spoon into lettuce leaves.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Basil Lamb Stir-Fry
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the garlic and chilies for 5 minutes.
Add the lamb and the garlic and chilies and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the oyster sauce, fish sauce, sugar and 3 tbsp water.
Stir in the basil and serve each portion topped with a fried egg.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Red-Braised Lamb Hong Shao

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces
Soy sauce (1 tbsp dark if you have it)

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the star anise and cinnamon.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the soy sauces, wine, sugar and water to just cover, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Uncover for the last 15 minutes and boil until the sauce is sticky. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Five-Spice Braised Lamb

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the five-spice.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the soy sauce, hoisin, wine, carrots and 400 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Reduce the sauce until it coats the meat. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Roast Chinese Char Siu-Style Lamb Chops
steps: Mix the hoisin, honey, soy sauce, five-spice, wine and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Set on a rack over a lined tray and brush with more marinade halfway.
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Slice and spoon over the pan juices.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Honey Soy Lamb Chops Traybake
steps: Mix the soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, ginger and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill.
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and the green spring onions.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Ginger Scallion Lamb Chops
steps: Pat the lamb chops dry and season with salt and white pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.

Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 1 minute, then the ginger and spring onions for 1 minute, then add the soy sauce, wine and 4 tbsp water.
Return the lamb chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Drizzle with the sesame oil.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Mapo-Style Lamb Tofu
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 5 minutes.
Add the lamb and the chili bean paste and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the stock, soy sauce and tofu; simmer 5 minutes, then thicken with the cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water.
Sprinkle with the ground Sichuan pepper and green spring onions.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Lion's Head Lamb Meatballs
steps: Mix the lamb with the egg, soy sauce, wine, cornstarch, ginger and spring onion whites and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 16 balls.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 6 minutes, turning; they finish cooking in the sauce.
Cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions gently in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Add the stock and cabbage; cover and simmer 20 minutes, until the meat is no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Serve the meatballs in bowls with the cabbage and broth.

recipes.title: Sichuan Spicy Bean Paste Braised Lamb

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the chili bean paste and star anise.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and ginger for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the soy sauce, daikon and water to just cover, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Scatter with Sichuan pepper and coriander. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Sichuan Mala Lamb Chops
steps: Pat the lamb chops dry and season with salt and the ground Sichuan pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the chili oil, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and 3 tbsp water.
Return the lamb chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the numbing chili sauce over.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Sichuan Dan Dan-Style Lamb Noodles
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the garlic and ginger for 5 minutes.
Add the lamb and the ginger and garlic and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the soy sauce and fry until the meat is crisp.
Divide the sesame paste, chili oil and Sichuan pepper between bowls, add the boiled noodles and bok choy and top with the crispy meat.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Nikujaga-Style Lamb Stew

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the onion.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and ginger for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the dashi, soy sauce, mirin, sugar, potatoes and carrots, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Let it sit 10 minutes so the potatoes soak up the sauce. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed short-grain rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Japanese Curry Lamb Stew

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the onions until golden.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and ginger for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add 700 ml water, the carrots, potatoes and apple, then stir in the curry roux for the last 10 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Serve over rice. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Japanese Miso Lamb Chops Bake
steps: Mix the miso, mirin, sugar and sake with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill.
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve with steamed short-grain rice.

recipes.title: Grilled Japanese Yuzu Kosho-Style Lamb Chops

ingredients.name: Yuzu kosho (or lemon zest and green chili)

steps: Mix the yuzu kosho, soy sauce and mirin with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill.
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Japanese Teriyaki Lamb Chops
steps: Pat the lamb chops dry and season with salt and a pinch of salt only (the sauce is salty).
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the soy sauce, mirin, sake and sugar and let it bubble 2 minutes until syrupy.
Return the lamb chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Turn to coat and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve with steamed short-grain rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Butter Ponzu Lamb Chops

ingredients.name: Ponzu (or soy sauce with lemon juice)

steps: Pat the lamb chops dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the ponzu and butter and swirl until glossy.
Return the lamb chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Scatter with the spring onions.
Serve with steamed short-grain rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Tsukune-Style Lamb Patties
steps: Mix the lamb with the egg, panko, spring onions, ginger and a pinch of salt and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 8 patties or logs.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 8 minutes, turning, until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir together the soy sauce, mirin and sugar and bubble until it coats the patties.
Serve glazed, with rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Soboro Lamb Rice Bowls
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the garlic and ginger for 5 minutes.
Add the lamb and the ginger and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the soy sauce, mirin and sugar and cook until dry and crumbly.
Scramble the eggs into fine curds separately, then top bowls of rice with the meat, egg and peas.
Serve with steamed short-grain rice.

recipes.title: Korean Galbi Jjim-Style Braised Lamb

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and black pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the soy sauce, sugar, grated pear, mushrooms and water to just cover, adding the carrot and daikon for the last 40 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Reduce the sauce until glossy and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Korean Dakdoritang-Style Lamb Stew

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the gochujang and chili flakes.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the soy sauce, sugar, potatoes, carrots, onion and 600 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Scatter with the green spring onions. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Korean Gochujang Lamb Chops Traybake
steps: Mix the gochujang, honey, soy sauce, sesame oil, vinegar and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill and turn once.
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Sprinkle with the green spring onions and serve with lettuce leaves for wrapping.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Grilled Korean Galbi-Style Lamb Chops
steps: Mix the soy sauce, sugar, grated pear, sesame oil and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill.
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Korean Soy Garlic Lamb Chops
steps: Pat the lamb chops dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.

Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 1 minute, then the garlic for 1 minute, then add the soy sauce, honey, vinegar and chili flakes and bubble until sticky.
Return the lamb chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Turn to coat.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Korean Gochujang Lamb Rice Bowls
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 5 minutes.
Add the lamb and the garlic and ginger and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the gochujang, soy sauce, sugar and sesame oil.
Spoon over rice with the cucumber, spinach and a fried egg.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Caramel Lamb Kho

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the sugar, cooked dry in the pot until dark amber, then.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and shallots for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the fish sauce, coconut water, pepper and eggs, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Reduce until the sauce is dark and sticky. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice or rice noodles with herbs.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Lemongrass Lamb Stew

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the curry powder and lemongrass.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and shallots for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the coconut milk, fish sauce, carrots, sweet potato and 300 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Serve with bread or rice noodles. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Grilled Vietnamese Lemongrass Lamb Chops
steps: Mix the lemongrass, garlic, shallots, fish sauce and sugar with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill.
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with mint and lime wedges.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Nuoc Cham Lamb Chops
steps: Pat the lamb chops dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and shallots for 1 minute, then the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the fish sauce, sugar, lime juice, chili and 3 tbsp water.
Return the lamb chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon over and scatter with mint.
Serve with rice or rice noodles with herbs.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Bun Cha-Style Lamb Patties
steps: Mix the lamb with half the fish sauce, half the sugar, the garlic and shallots and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 8 patties or logs.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 8 minutes, turning, until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Cook the garlic and shallots gently in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Stir together the rest of the fish sauce and sugar with the lime juice and 150 ml warm water as a dipping sauce.
Serve with the noodles, lettuce and herbs, dipping into the sauce.

recipes.title: Indian Butter Lamb Curry

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the garam masala, cumin and chili.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onions, garlic and ginger for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the tomatoes and 150 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Stir in the cream, butter and fenugreek and simmer 5 minutes. Taste for salt.
Serve with basmati rice or naan.

recipes.title: Indian Rogan Josh-Style Lamb Curry

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the chili, fennel, ginger, cardamom and cinnamon.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onions, garlic and ginger for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the yogurt, a spoonful at a time, and 400 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Simmer uncovered until the sauce is thick and red. Taste for salt.
Serve with basmati rice or naan.

recipes.title: Indian Korma Lamb Curry

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the cardamom, coriander and turmeric.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onions, garlic and ginger for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the yogurt, almonds, coconut milk and 200 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Scatter with toasted almonds. Taste for salt.
Serve with basmati rice or naan.

recipes.title: Indian Vindaloo-Style Lamb Curry

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the chili, cayenne, cumin and mustard seeds.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onions, garlic and ginger for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the vinegar, tomatoes and 250 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Let it rest 10 minutes; it tastes even better the next day. Taste for salt.
Serve with basmati rice or naan.

recipes.title: Indian Saag Lamb Curry

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the garam masala, cumin, turmeric and chili.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onions, garlic and ginger for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add 300 ml water, then the spinach for the last 10 minutes; blend half the sauce if you like it smooth, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Stir in the cream. Taste for salt.
Serve with basmati rice or naan.

recipes.title: Roast Indian Tandoori-Style Lamb Chops
steps: Mix the yogurt, garlic, ginger, spices and lemon juice with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill.
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with the raw onion rings and lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Indian Tikka Lamb Chops Skewers
steps: Mix the yogurt, garlic, ginger and spices with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Thread on skewers with the peppers and onion and cook on the grill.
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with mint yogurt.

recipes.title: Indian Masala Lamb Chops
steps: Pat the lamb chops dry and season with salt and the garam masala, turmeric and chili.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onions, garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the onions, garlic and ginger for 5 minutes, then the tomatoes and 4 tbsp water until jammy.
Return the lamb chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Scatter with coriander.
Serve with basmati rice or naan.

recipes.title: Indian Keema Lamb Mince
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the onions, garlic and ginger for 5 minutes.
Add the lamb and the garam masala, cumin and turmeric and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the tomatoes, then the peas for the last 5 minutes.
Scatter with coriander.
Serve with basmati rice or naan.

recipes.title: Indian Seekh Kebab-Style Lamb Kebabs
steps: Mix the lamb with the garam masala, cumin, chili powder, coriander, green chili, garlic and ginger and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 8 patties or logs.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 8 minutes, turning, until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Cook the onions, garlic and ginger gently in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Stir together the yogurt mixed with chopped mint.
Serve with the mint yogurt and sliced onion.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Black Lamb Curry

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the curry powder, pepper and cinnamon.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion, garlic, ginger and curry leaves for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the tamarind and 400 ml water, then the coconut milk for the last 20 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Simmer until dark and thick. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Coconut Lamb Curry

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the curry powder, turmeric and chili.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion, garlic, ginger and curry leaves for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the coconut milk and 200 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Finish with the lime juice. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Devilled Lamb Chops
steps: Pat the lamb chops dry and season with salt and the chili flakes.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion, garlic, ginger and curry leaves for 1 minute, then the onion and pepper for 3 minutes, then the ketchup, chili sauce, soy sauce and 3 tbsp water.
Return the lamb chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Toss to coat.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Indonesian Rendang-Style Braised Lamb

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the ginger, coriander and turmeric.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the shallots, garlic and chilies for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the coconut milk, lemongrass, sugar and 200 ml water; uncover for the last hour and stir often until almost dry, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Stir in the toasted coconut and fry a few minutes more until dark. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Indonesian Opor-Style Lamb Curry

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the coriander, cumin and turmeric.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the shallots, garlic and chilies for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the coconut milk, lemongrass, lime leaves and 200 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Scatter with fried shallots if you have them. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Indonesian Satay Lamb Chops Skewers
steps: Mix the kecap manis, coriander, shallots and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Thread on skewers and cook on the grill; meanwhile simmer the peanut butter, coconut milk, lime juice and chili flakes into a sauce.
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with the peanut sauce.

recipes.title: Indonesian Nasi Goreng-Style Lamb Fried Rice
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the shallots, garlic and chilies for 5 minutes.
Add the lamb and the shallots, garlic and chilies and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the cold rice, kecap manis and soy sauce and fry until hot and smoky.
Serve topped with a fried egg and cucumber on the side.

recipes.title: Malaysian Kapitan-Style Lamb Curry

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the chili garlic sauce, lemongrass and turmeric.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the shallots, garlic and ginger for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the coconut milk, tamarind and 200 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Season with sugar and salt. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Malaysian Kurma-Style Lamb Curry

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the curry powder, cinnamon and cardamom.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the shallots, garlic and ginger for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the coconut milk, potatoes and 200 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Simmer until the potatoes are soft. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Grilled Malaysian Ayam Percik-Style Lamb Chops
steps: Mix the coconut milk, lemongrass, turmeric, chili garlic sauce and sugar with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill, basting with marinade twice.
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with cucumber.

recipes.title: Filipino Adobo Braised Lamb

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the peppercorns and bay leaves.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and 200 ml water; let it boil 2 minutes before stirring so the vinegar mellows, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Reduce the sauce until it coats the meat. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Filipino Caldereta-Style Lamb Stew

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and black pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the tomato sauce and 300 ml water, adding the potatoes and carrots for the last 30 minutes and the pepper for the last 10, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Stir in the pate and olives. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Filipino Sinigang-Style Lamb Sour Soup

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and black pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add 1.5 litres water, the tamarind and tomatoes, adding the radish and beans for the last 10 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Stir in the spinach and fish sauce. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Grilled Filipino Inasal-Style Lamb Chops
steps: Mix the lemongrass, vinegar, citrus juice, annatto and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill, basting with the butter.
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with soy-vinegar dip.

recipes.title: Filipino Bistek-Style Lamb Chops
steps: Pat the lamb chops dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the onion rings for 3 minutes, then the soy sauce, lemon juice and 4 tbsp water.
Return the lamb chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the onions and sauce over.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Mexican Chipotle Lamb Tinga

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the cumin and oregano.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the tomatoes, chipotles and 200 ml water; shred the meat at the end, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Serve in tortillas with avocado and crema. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Mexican Red Chile Lamb Guisado

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces
Dried guajillo chilies, seeded and soaked
Dried ancho chilies, seeded and soaked

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the cumin and oregano.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the chilies blended with the stock, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Serve with rice and beans. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Mexican Salsa Verde Lamb Guisado

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and black pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the tomatillos, jalapeños and coriander blended with the stock, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Scatter with more coriander. Taste for salt.
Serve with warm tortillas and rice.

recipes.title: Mexican Barbacoa-Style Braised Lamb

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the cumin and oregano.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the chipotles blended with the vinegar and 300 ml water, plus the bay leaves; shred the meat at the end, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Squeeze over the lime and serve in tortillas. Taste for salt.
Serve with warm tortillas and rice.

recipes.title: Roast Mexican Achiote Lamb Chops
steps: Mix the achiote paste, citrus juice, oregano and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay in a roasting dish with the marinade.
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with quick-pickled red onion.

recipes.title: Grilled Mexican Carne Asada-Style Lamb Chops
steps: Mix the citrus juice, cumin, chili powder, coriander and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Shake off excess marinade.
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Slice thinly and serve in tortillas with salsa.
Serve with warm tortillas and rice.

recipes.title: Roast Mexican Al Pastor-Style Lamb Chops
steps: Mix the soaked chilies, chipotles, pineapple juice, vinegar, cumin and garlic, blended with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on a lined tray with the pineapple slices around it.
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Chop with the pineapple and serve in tortillas.
Serve with warm tortillas and rice.

recipes.title: Mexican Fajita Lamb Chops
steps: Pat the lamb chops dry and season with salt and the chili powder, cumin and paprika.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the peppers and onion until charred at the edges, then a splash of water.
Return the lamb chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Slice the meat, squeeze over the lime and pile into tortillas.
Serve with warm tortillas and rice.

recipes.title: Mexican Mole-Style Lamb Chops
steps: Pat the lamb chops dry and season with salt and ground cumin.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the mole paste and stock and simmer until thick, then melt in the chocolate.
Return the lamb chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the sauce over and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve with warm tortillas and rice.

recipes.title: Mexican Picadillo Lamb Mince
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the onion and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the lamb and the cumin and oregano and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the tomatoes, potatoes, carrots and 150 ml water; simmer 15 minutes until tender.
Serve with rice or in tortillas.

recipes.title: Mexican Albondigas Lamb Meatballs
steps: Mix the lamb with the egg, rice, mint and half the garlic and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 16 balls.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 6 minutes, turning; they finish cooking in the sauce.
Cook the onion and garlic gently in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes blended with the chipotle, then the stock; simmer the meatballs 25 minutes, until the meat is no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Serve as a soupy stew.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Chili con Carne Lamb Stew

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the chili powder, cumin and oregano.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the tomatoes, beans and stock, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Serve with cheese and sour cream. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Cumin Lime Lamb Chops Traybake
steps: Mix the cumin, chili powder, lime juice and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Spread on a tray with the peppers and onion.
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with tortillas and salsa.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Queso Lamb Chops
steps: Pat the lamb chops dry and season with salt and the chili powder.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the jalapeño, then the milk and cornstarch until thick; melt in the cheese off the heat.
Return the lamb chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Pour the queso over.
Serve with rice and beans.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Taco Lamb
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the onion and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the lamb and the chili powder, cumin and paprika and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the tomato sauce and 100 ml water and simmer until thick.
Fill the taco shells with the meat, lettuce and cheese.
Serve with rice and beans.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Enchilada Lamb Bake

ingredients.name: Enchilada sauce (or tomato passata with chili)

steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the onion and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the lamb and the chili powder and cumin and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in half the sauce and the beans.
Roll the filling in tortillas, cover with the rest of the sauce and cheese and bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes.
Serve with rice and beans.

recipes.title: Jamaican Curry Lamb Curry

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the curry powder, allspice and thyme.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion, garlic, spring onions and scotch bonnet for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add 500 ml water and the potatoes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Simmer uncovered until thick. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice and peas.

recipes.title: Jamaican Brown Stew Lamb Stew

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the allspice and thyme.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion, garlic, spring onions and scotch bonnet for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the browning sauce, ketchup and 400 ml water, with the carrots and pepper for the last 15 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Serve with rice. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Roast Jamaican Jerk Lamb Chops
steps: Mix the jerk seasoning, allspice, sugar, lime, soy sauce, spring onions, garlic and scotch bonnet blended with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill.
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Jamaican Escovitch Lamb Chops

ingredients.name: Red bell pepper, cut into thin strips

steps: Pat the lamb chops dry and season with salt and the allspice.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.

Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion, garlic, spring onions and scotch bonnet for 1 minute, then the onion, carrot, pepper and scotch bonnet for 2 minutes, then the vinegar and sugar for 1 minute.
Return the lamb chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Pour the hot pickled vegetables over.
Serve with rice and peas.

recipes.title: Cuban Ropa Vieja-Style Lamb Stew

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the cumin and oregano.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion, pepper and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the tomatoes, wine, bay leaves and 300 ml water; shred the meat at the end, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Stir in the olives. Taste for salt.
Serve with white rice and black beans.

recipes.title: Roast Cuban Mojo Lamb Chops
steps: Mix the citrus juice, cumin, oregano and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay in a roasting dish on the onion rings.
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Spoon over the pan juices.
Serve with white rice and black beans.

recipes.title: Cuban Mojo Lamb Chops
steps: Pat the lamb chops dry and season with salt and the cumin and oregano.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion, pepper and garlic for 1 minute, then the garlic for 1 minute, then the citrus juice; bubble 2 minutes.
Return the lamb chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the garlicky mojo over.
Serve with white rice and black beans.

recipes.title: Cuban Picadillo Lamb Mince
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the onion, pepper and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the lamb and the cumin and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the tomato sauce, olives, raisins and capers and simmer 15 minutes.
Serve with rice and fried plantains.

recipes.title: Roast Peruvian Pollo a la Brasa-Style Lamb Chops
steps: Mix the soy sauce, lime, cumin, paprika, oregano and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill.
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with green sauce and fries.

recipes.title: Peruvian Anticucho-Style Lamb Chops Skewers

ingredients.name: Aji panca paste (or 2 tsp paprika and 1 tsp chili powder)

steps: Mix the vinegar, chili paste, cumin, oregano and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Thread on skewers and cook on the grill.
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with boiled potatoes and corn.

recipes.title: Peruvian Seco-Style Lamb Stew

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces
Green chili (aji amarillo if you can find it)

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and ground cumin.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the coriander blended with the chili and beer, then the carrots for the last 30 minutes and the peas for the last 5, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Serve with rice and beans. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Brazilian Moqueca-Style Lamb Stew

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces
Palm oil (or olive oil with 1 tsp paprika)

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the paprika.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the coconut milk, pepper and tomatoes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Stir in the lime juice and coriander. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice and black beans.

recipes.title: Brazilian Feijoada-Style Lamb Stew

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and black pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the beans, sausage, bay leaves and stock, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Serve with rice, greens and orange slices. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Grilled Brazilian Churrasco-Style Lamb Chops
steps: Mix the coarse salt and garlic only with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Mix the onion, tomatoes, parsley and vinegar as a vinaigrette salsa.
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Slice and serve with the salsa.
Serve with rice and black beans.

recipes.title: Brazilian Acebolado Lamb Chops
steps: Pat the lamb chops dry and season with salt and the paprika.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the onion rings in the butter until soft and golden, then the vinegar.
Return the lamb chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Pile the onions on top.
Serve with rice and black beans.

recipes.title: Grilled Argentine Chimichurri Lamb Chops
steps: Mix salt, a little of the oregano and the oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Mix the parsley, garlic, the rest of the oregano, chili, vinegar and oil as chimichurri.
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Slice and spoon over the chimichurri.
Serve with roast potatoes or a green salad.

recipes.title: Argentine Salsa Criolla Lamb Chops
steps: Pat the lamb chops dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Meanwhile, off the heat, mix the onion, pepper, tomatoes, vinegar and oil for the salsa while the meat rests.
Spoon the salsa over.
Serve with roast potatoes or a green salad.

recipes.title: Argentine Carbonada-Style Lamb Stew

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and paprika.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the tomatoes and stock, adding the vegetables and fruit for the last 30 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Serve in bowls. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Italian Cacciatore Braised Lamb

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the oregano and rosemary.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the wine (boil 1 minute), tomatoes, pepper and mushrooms, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Stir in the olives. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Ragù Braised Lamb

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and black pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the wine, passata, carrot, celery and bay leaves; shred the meat at the end, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Toss with the pasta and serve with parmesan. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Peperonata Braised Lamb

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and black pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the peppers, tomatoes and vinegar, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Stir in the capers and basil. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Alla Pizzaiola Braised Lamb

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the oregano.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the tomatoes and capers, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Stir in the olives and basil. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Roast Italian Porchetta-Style Lamb Chops
steps: Mix the fennel seeds, rosemary, lemon zest, chili and garlic with oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay in a roasting dish and pour the wine around.
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Slice and spoon over the pan juices.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Lemon Rosemary Lamb Chops Traybake
steps: Mix the lemon juice, rosemary, garlic and oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Spread on a tray with the potatoes, onion and lemon slices (start the potatoes 15 minutes earlier).
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Spoon over the pan juices.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Piccata Lamb Chops
steps: Pat the lamb chops dry and season with salt and black pepper; dust lightly with flour.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the stock, lemon juice and capers and bubble 2 minutes, then swirl in the butter.
Return the lamb chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Scatter with parsley.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Marsala Lamb Chops
steps: Pat the lamb chops dry and season with salt and black pepper; dust lightly with flour.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the mushrooms in the butter until golden, then the Marsala and stock and reduce by half.
Return the lamb chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the mushrooms and sauce over.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Saltimbocca-Style Lamb Chops
steps: Pat the lamb chops dry and season with salt and black pepper; lay a sage leaf and a slice of prosciutto on each piece and press.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the wine and butter and bubble 1 minute.
Return the lamb chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the buttery sauce over.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Polpette Lamb Meatballs
steps: Mix the lamb with the egg, breadcrumbs, parmesan, parsley and half the garlic and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 16 balls.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 6 minutes, turning; they finish cooking in the sauce.
Cook the onion and garlic gently in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Add the passata and simmer the meatballs gently for 20 minutes, until the meat is no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Tear over the basil and serve with bread or pasta.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Bolognese-Style Lamb Ragù
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the onion and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the lamb and the carrot and celery and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the wine, then the passata; simmer 30 minutes.
Toss with the pasta and parmesan.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: French Coq au Vin-Style Braised Lamb

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the thyme and flour.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the shallots and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the wine, bay leaves and 250 ml stock or water; fry the bacon, mushrooms and onions separately and add for the last 20 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Scatter with parsley. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: French Provençal Braised Lamb

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the herbes de Provence.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the shallots and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the wine, tomatoes and fennel, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Stir in the olives. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: French Cider and Mustard Braised Lamb

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the thyme.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the shallots and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the cider and mustard, adding the apples for the last 15 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Stir in the crème fraîche. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: Roast French Dijon Herb Lamb Chops
steps: Mix the mustard, herbs and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on a lined tray and press on the breadcrumbs mixed with butter.
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with the pan juices.

recipes.title: French Au Poivre Lamb Chops
steps: Pat the lamb chops dry and season with salt and the crushed peppercorns, pressed on both sides.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the shallots and garlic for 1 minute, then the brandy (careful, it can flame), then the cream; bubble 2 minutes.
Return the lamb chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the peppery cream over.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: French Dijon Cream Lamb Chops
steps: Pat the lamb chops dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the shallots and garlic for 1 minute, then the wine and reduce by half, then the cream and mustard.
Return the lamb chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Stir in the tarragon and spoon over.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: French Beurre Blanc Lamb Chops
steps: Pat the lamb chops dry and season with salt and white pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the shallots and garlic for 1 minute, then the wine and vinegar until almost gone, then whisk in the butter a cube at a time off the heat.
Return the lamb chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the sauce over and scatter with chives.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: French Steak Haché Lamb Patties

ingredients.name: Black pepper, coarsely crushed (or green peppercorns)

steps: Mix the lamb with the egg yolk, mustard and half the shallots and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 8 patties or logs.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 8 minutes, turning, until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Cook the shallots and garlic gently in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Stir together the cream and peppercorns and bubble 2 minutes.
Spoon the sauce over and serve with fries or salad.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: Spanish Chorizo and Chickpea Lamb Stew

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the smoked paprika.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the chorizo, tomatoes, chickpeas and 300 ml water, with the spinach at the end, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Drizzle with olive oil. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread or potatoes.

recipes.title: Spanish Sherry and Olive Braised Lamb

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the paprika.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the sherry, bay leaves, pepper and 300 ml stock or water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Stir in the olives. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread or potatoes.

recipes.title: Spanish Saffron and Almond Lamb Pepitoria-Style

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the saffron.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the wine and stock; at the end blend the almonds and egg yolks with some sauce and stir back in, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Chop the egg whites over the top. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread or potatoes.

recipes.title: Spanish Pimentón Lamb Chops Traybake
steps: Mix the smoked paprika, lemon juice, garlic and oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Spread on a tray with the potatoes, pepper and onion (start the potatoes 15 minutes earlier).
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Scatter with parsley.
Serve with crusty bread or potatoes.

recipes.title: Spanish Al Ajillo Lamb Chops
steps: Pat the lamb chops dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the sliced garlic and chili gently until golden, then the wine.
Return the lamb chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Scatter with parsley and serve with bread.
Serve with crusty bread or potatoes.

recipes.title: Spanish Albondigas en Salsa Lamb Meatballs
steps: Mix the lamb with the egg, breadcrumbs, paprika and half the garlic and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 16 balls.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 6 minutes, turning; they finish cooking in the sauce.
Cook the onion and garlic gently in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Add the wine and tomatoes and simmer the meatballs 20 minutes, until the meat is no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Scatter with parsley.
Serve with crusty bread or potatoes.

recipes.title: Roast Portuguese Piri-Piri Lamb Chops
steps: Mix the chilies, paprika, lemon, vinegar, oregano and garlic blended with oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill.
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with fries or rice.

recipes.title: Portuguese Alentejana-Style Braised Lamb

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the paprika.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the wine and bay leaves; add the clams for the last 5 minutes until they open, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Scatter with coriander. Taste for salt.
Serve with potatoes or rice.

recipes.title: Portuguese Garlic Wine Lamb Chops Bitoque-Style
steps: Pat the lamb chops dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the garlic and bay leaves, then the wine; bubble 2 minutes.
Return the lamb chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Serve each portion topped with a fried egg.

recipes.title: Greek Stifado Lamb Stew

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the cinnamon and cloves.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the wine, vinegar, tomatoes, bay leaves and whole shallots, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Serve with rice or orzo. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Greek Lemon Oregano Lamb Lemonato

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the oregano.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the lemon juice, stock and potatoes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Simmer uncovered until the sauce is reduced and lemony. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice, potatoes or warm pitta.

recipes.title: Greek Souvlaki Lamb Chops Skewers
steps: Mix the lemon juice, oregano, garlic and oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Thread on skewers and cook on the grill; mix the yogurt and squeezed cucumber as tzatziki.
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve in warm pitta with the tzatziki.

recipes.title: Greek Feta and Tomato Lamb Chops
steps: Pat the lamb chops dry and season with salt and the oregano.
