Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the cherry tomatoes until they burst, then the olives.
Return the lamb chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Crumble over the feta.
Serve with rice, potatoes or warm pitta.

recipes.title: Greek Keftedes Lamb Meatballs
steps: Mix the lamb with the egg, breadcrumbs, mint, oregano, onion and garlic and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 16 balls.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 8 minutes, turning, until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir together the yogurt seasoned with salt and a little garlic as a dip.
Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Turkish Pepper Paste Lamb Güveç-Style

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces
Tomato paste (or Turkish red pepper paste)

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the pepper paste and Aleppo pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the tomatoes, eggplant, peppers and 300 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Serve with yogurt. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Turkish Şiş Lamb Chops Skewers

ingredients.name: Tomato paste (or Turkish red pepper paste)

steps: Mix the yogurt, pepper paste, cumin and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Thread on skewers and cook on the grill.
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with the onion tossed with sumac.

recipes.title: Turkish Köfte Lamb Patties
steps: Mix the lamb with the egg, breadcrumbs, cumin, pepper, parsley, onion and garlic and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 8 patties or logs.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 8 minutes, turning, until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir together the yogurt with a pinch of salt for serving.
Serve with flatbread, salad and the yogurt.

recipes.title: Moroccan Apricot Lamb Tagine

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the ras el hanout and cinnamon.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion, garlic and ginger for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the apricots, chickpeas, honey and 500 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Scatter with almonds. Taste for salt.
Serve with couscous.

recipes.title: Moroccan Preserved Lemon and Olive Lamb Tagine

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces
Preserved lemons, chopped (or 1 lemon, zested and juiced)

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the turmeric and ginger.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion, garlic and ginger for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the preserved lemon and 400 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Stir in the olives and coriander. Taste for salt.
Serve with couscous.

recipes.title: Roast Moroccan Chermoula Lamb Chops
steps: Mix the herbs, cumin, paprika, lemon and garlic blended with oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on a lined tray.
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Moroccan Kefta Lamb Tagine
steps: Mix the lamb with the cumin, paprika, parsley and half the onion and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 8 patties or logs.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 6 minutes, turning; they finish cooking in the sauce.
Cook the onion, garlic and ginger gently in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes; simmer the meatballs 15 minutes, then crack in the eggs, cover and cook 6 minutes, until the meat is no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Serve with bread.

recipes.title: American Pot Roast-Style Braised Lamb

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the thyme and tomato paste.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the stock, with the carrots and potatoes for the last hour, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Thicken the gravy if you like and serve. Taste for salt.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: American BBQ Lamb Chops Traybake
steps: Mix the paprika, sugar, garlic powder and half the sauce with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill, brushing with the rest of the sauce for the last 10 minutes.
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with coleslaw.

recipes.title: Roast American Maple Mustard Lamb Chops
steps: Mix the maple, mustard, vinegar and rosemary with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on a lined tray.
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Spoon over the pan juices.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: American Honey Garlic Lamb Chops
steps: Pat the lamb chops dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the garlic for 30 seconds, then the honey, soy sauce and vinegar; bubble until sticky.
Return the lamb chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Turn to coat.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: American Creamy Tuscan-Style Lamb Chops
steps: Pat the lamb chops dry and season with salt and the Italian seasoning.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the sun-dried tomatoes and garlic, then the cream and parmesan, then the spinach until wilted.
Return the lamb chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon over.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: American Sloppy Joe-Style Lamb Sandwiches
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the onion and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the lamb and the pepper and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, sugar and 100 ml water and simmer 10 minutes.
Pile onto toasted buns.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: British Ale Lamb Stew

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season well with salt and the flour and thyme.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the lamb in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the ale, Worcestershire sauce, bay leaves, carrots and 200 ml stock, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the lamb is very tender.
Serve with mash or crusty bread. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: British Honey Mustard Lamb Chops Traybake
steps: Mix the mustard, honey, thyme and oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the lamb chops and leave to marinate 1 to 8 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Spread on a tray with the potatoes and parsnips (start the vegetables 15 minutes earlier).
Grill about 3 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Spoon over the sticky juices.
Serve with mashed potatoes and greens.

recipes.title: British Peppercorn Lamb Chops
steps: Pat the lamb chops dry and season with salt and the crushed peppercorns.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the cream and mustard; bubble 2 minutes.
Return the lamb chops with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon over and serve with chips or salad.
Serve with mashed potatoes and greens.

recipes.title: Thai Garlic Pepper Turkey Steaks

ingredients.name: Turkey breast, cut into 1 cm steaks

steps: Pat the turkey steaks dry and season with salt and the white pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and chilies for 1 minute, then the garlic for 1 minute, then add the oyster sauce, fish sauce, sugar and 4 tbsp water.
Return the turkey steaks with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the glossy garlic sauce over.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Larb Turkey Lettuce Cups
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the garlic and chilies for 5 minutes.
Add the turkey and the garlic and chilies and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (74 °C / 165 °F).
Stir in the lime juice and fish sauce.
Toss with the onion, mint and toasted rice powder and spoon into lettuce leaves.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Basil Turkey Stir-Fry
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the garlic and chilies for 5 minutes.
Add the turkey and the garlic and chilies and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (74 °C / 165 °F).
Stir in the oyster sauce, fish sauce, sugar and 3 tbsp water.
Stir in the basil and serve each portion topped with a fried egg.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Ginger Scallion Turkey Steaks

ingredients.name: Turkey breast, cut into 1 cm steaks

steps: Pat the turkey steaks dry and season with salt and white pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.

Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 1 minute, then the ginger and spring onions for 1 minute, then add the soy sauce, wine and 4 tbsp water.
Return the turkey steaks with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Drizzle with the sesame oil.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Lion's Head Turkey Meatballs
steps: Mix the turkey with the egg, soy sauce, wine, cornstarch, ginger and spring onion whites and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 16 balls.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 6 minutes, turning; they finish cooking in the sauce.
Cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions gently in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Add the stock and cabbage; cover and simmer 20 minutes, until the meat is no longer pink inside (74 °C / 165 °F).
Serve the meatballs in bowls with the cabbage and broth.

recipes.title: Sichuan Mala Turkey Steaks

ingredients.name: Turkey breast, cut into 1 cm steaks

steps: Pat the turkey steaks dry and season with salt and the ground Sichuan pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the chili oil, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and 3 tbsp water.
Return the turkey steaks with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the numbing chili sauce over.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Sichuan Dan Dan-Style Turkey Noodles
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the garlic and ginger for 5 minutes.
Add the turkey and the ginger and garlic and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (74 °C / 165 °F).
Stir in the soy sauce and fry until the meat is crisp.
Divide the sesame paste, chili oil and Sichuan pepper between bowls, add the boiled noodles and bok choy and top with the crispy meat.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Teriyaki Turkey Steaks

ingredients.name: Turkey breast, cut into 1 cm steaks

steps: Pat the turkey steaks dry and season with salt and a pinch of salt only (the sauce is salty).
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the soy sauce, mirin, sake and sugar and let it bubble 2 minutes until syrupy.
Return the turkey steaks with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Turn to coat and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve with steamed short-grain rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Butter Ponzu Turkey Steaks

ingredients.name: Turkey breast, cut into 1 cm steaks
Ponzu (or soy sauce with lemon juice)

steps: Pat the turkey steaks dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the ponzu and butter and swirl until glossy.
Return the turkey steaks with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Scatter with the spring onions.
Serve with steamed short-grain rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Tsukune-Style Turkey Patties
steps: Mix the turkey with the egg, panko, spring onions, ginger and a pinch of salt and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 8 patties or logs.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 8 minutes, turning, until no longer pink inside (74 °C / 165 °F).
Stir together the soy sauce, mirin and sugar and bubble until it coats the patties.
Serve glazed, with rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Soboro Turkey Rice Bowls
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the garlic and ginger for 5 minutes.
Add the turkey and the ginger and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (74 °C / 165 °F).
Stir in the soy sauce, mirin and sugar and cook until dry and crumbly.
Scramble the eggs into fine curds separately, then top bowls of rice with the meat, egg and peas.
Serve with steamed short-grain rice.

recipes.title: Korean Soy Garlic Turkey Steaks

ingredients.name: Turkey breast, cut into 1 cm steaks

steps: Pat the turkey steaks dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.

Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 1 minute, then the garlic for 1 minute, then add the soy sauce, honey, vinegar and chili flakes and bubble until sticky.
Return the turkey steaks with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Turn to coat.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Korean Gochujang Turkey Rice Bowls
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 5 minutes.
Add the turkey and the garlic and ginger and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (74 °C / 165 °F).
Stir in the gochujang, soy sauce, sugar and sesame oil.
Spoon over rice with the cucumber, spinach and a fried egg.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Nuoc Cham Turkey Steaks

ingredients.name: Turkey breast, cut into 1 cm steaks

steps: Pat the turkey steaks dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and shallots for 1 minute, then the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the fish sauce, sugar, lime juice, chili and 3 tbsp water.
Return the turkey steaks with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon over and scatter with mint.
Serve with rice or rice noodles with herbs.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Bun Cha-Style Turkey Patties
steps: Mix the turkey with half the fish sauce, half the sugar, the garlic and shallots and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 8 patties or logs.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 8 minutes, turning, until no longer pink inside (74 °C / 165 °F).
Cook the garlic and shallots gently in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Stir together the rest of the fish sauce and sugar with the lime juice and 150 ml warm water as a dipping sauce.
Serve with the noodles, lettuce and herbs, dipping into the sauce.

recipes.title: Indian Masala Turkey Steaks

ingredients.name: Turkey breast, cut into 1 cm steaks

steps: Pat the turkey steaks dry and season with salt and the garam masala, turmeric and chili.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onions, garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the onions, garlic and ginger for 5 minutes, then the tomatoes and 4 tbsp water until jammy.
Return the turkey steaks with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Scatter with coriander.
Serve with basmati rice or naan.

recipes.title: Indian Keema Turkey Mince
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the onions, garlic and ginger for 5 minutes.
Add the turkey and the garam masala, cumin and turmeric and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (74 °C / 165 °F).
Stir in the tomatoes, then the peas for the last 5 minutes.
Scatter with coriander.
Serve with basmati rice or naan.

recipes.title: Indian Seekh Kebab-Style Turkey Kebabs
steps: Mix the turkey with the garam masala, cumin, chili powder, coriander, green chili, garlic and ginger and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 8 patties or logs.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 8 minutes, turning, until no longer pink inside (74 °C / 165 °F).
Cook the onions, garlic and ginger gently in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Stir together the yogurt mixed with chopped mint.
Serve with the mint yogurt and sliced onion.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Devilled Turkey Steaks

ingredients.name: Turkey breast, cut into 1 cm steaks

steps: Pat the turkey steaks dry and season with salt and the chili flakes.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion, garlic, ginger and curry leaves for 1 minute, then the onion and pepper for 3 minutes, then the ketchup, chili sauce, soy sauce and 3 tbsp water.
Return the turkey steaks with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Toss to coat.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Indonesian Nasi Goreng-Style Turkey Fried Rice
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the shallots, garlic and chilies for 5 minutes.
Add the turkey and the shallots, garlic and chilies and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (74 °C / 165 °F).
Stir in the cold rice, kecap manis and soy sauce and fry until hot and smoky.
Serve topped with a fried egg and cucumber on the side.

recipes.title: Filipino Bistek-Style Turkey Steaks

ingredients.name: Turkey breast, cut into 1 cm steaks

steps: Pat the turkey steaks dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the onion rings for 3 minutes, then the soy sauce, lemon juice and 4 tbsp water.
Return the turkey steaks with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the onions and sauce over.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Mexican Fajita Turkey Steaks

ingredients.name: Turkey breast, cut into 1 cm steaks

steps: Pat the turkey steaks dry and season with salt and the chili powder, cumin and paprika.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the peppers and onion until charred at the edges, then a splash of water.
Return the turkey steaks with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Slice the meat, squeeze over the lime and pile into tortillas.
Serve with warm tortillas and rice.

recipes.title: Mexican Mole-Style Turkey Steaks

ingredients.name: Turkey breast, cut into 1 cm steaks

steps: Pat the turkey steaks dry and season with salt and ground cumin.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the mole paste and stock and simmer until thick, then melt in the chocolate.
Return the turkey steaks with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the sauce over and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve with warm tortillas and rice.

recipes.title: Mexican Picadillo Turkey Mince
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the onion and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the turkey and the cumin and oregano and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (74 °C / 165 °F).
Stir in the tomatoes, potatoes, carrots and 150 ml water; simmer 15 minutes until tender.
Serve with rice or in tortillas.

recipes.title: Mexican Albondigas Turkey Meatballs
steps: Mix the turkey with the egg, rice, mint and half the garlic and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 16 balls.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 6 minutes, turning; they finish cooking in the sauce.
Cook the onion and garlic gently in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes blended with the chipotle, then the stock; simmer the meatballs 25 minutes, until the meat is no longer pink inside (74 °C / 165 °F).
Serve as a soupy stew.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Queso Turkey Steaks

ingredients.name: Turkey breast, cut into 1 cm steaks

steps: Pat the turkey steaks dry and season with salt and the chili powder.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the jalapeño, then the milk and cornstarch until thick; melt in the cheese off the heat.
Return the turkey steaks with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Pour the queso over.
Serve with rice and beans.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Taco Turkey
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the onion and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the turkey and the chili powder, cumin and paprika and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (74 °C / 165 °F).
Stir in the tomato sauce and 100 ml water and simmer until thick.
Fill the taco shells with the meat, lettuce and cheese.
Serve with rice and beans.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Enchilada Turkey Bake

ingredients.name: Enchilada sauce (or tomato passata with chili)

steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the onion and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the turkey and the chili powder and cumin and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (74 °C / 165 °F).
Stir in half the sauce and the beans.
Roll the filling in tortillas, cover with the rest of the sauce and cheese and bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes.
Serve with rice and beans.

recipes.title: Jamaican Escovitch Turkey Steaks

ingredients.name: Turkey breast, cut into 1 cm steaks
Red bell pepper, cut into thin strips

steps: Pat the turkey steaks dry and season with salt and the allspice.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.

Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion, garlic, spring onions and scotch bonnet for 1 minute, then the onion, carrot, pepper and scotch bonnet for 2 minutes, then the vinegar and sugar for 1 minute.
Return the turkey steaks with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Pour the hot pickled vegetables over.
Serve with rice and peas.

recipes.title: Cuban Mojo Turkey Steaks

ingredients.name: Turkey breast, cut into 1 cm steaks

steps: Pat the turkey steaks dry and season with salt and the cumin and oregano.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion, pepper and garlic for 1 minute, then the garlic for 1 minute, then the citrus juice; bubble 2 minutes.
Return the turkey steaks with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the garlicky mojo over.
Serve with white rice and black beans.

recipes.title: Cuban Picadillo Turkey Mince
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the onion, pepper and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the turkey and the cumin and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (74 °C / 165 °F).
Stir in the tomato sauce, olives, raisins and capers and simmer 15 minutes.
Serve with rice and fried plantains.

recipes.title: Brazilian Acebolado Turkey Steaks

ingredients.name: Turkey breast, cut into 1 cm steaks

steps: Pat the turkey steaks dry and season with salt and the paprika.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the onion rings in the butter until soft and golden, then the vinegar.
Return the turkey steaks with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Pile the onions on top.
Serve with rice and black beans.

recipes.title: Argentine Salsa Criolla Turkey Steaks

ingredients.name: Turkey breast, cut into 1 cm steaks

steps: Pat the turkey steaks dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Meanwhile, off the heat, mix the onion, pepper, tomatoes, vinegar and oil for the salsa while the meat rests.
Spoon the salsa over.
Serve with roast potatoes or a green salad.

recipes.title: Italian Piccata Turkey Steaks

ingredients.name: Turkey breast, cut into 1 cm steaks

steps: Pat the turkey steaks dry and season with salt and black pepper; dust lightly with flour.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the stock, lemon juice and capers and bubble 2 minutes, then swirl in the butter.
Return the turkey steaks with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Scatter with parsley.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Marsala Turkey Steaks

ingredients.name: Turkey breast, cut into 1 cm steaks

steps: Pat the turkey steaks dry and season with salt and black pepper; dust lightly with flour.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the mushrooms in the butter until golden, then the Marsala and stock and reduce by half.
Return the turkey steaks with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the mushrooms and sauce over.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Saltimbocca-Style Turkey Steaks

ingredients.name: Turkey breast, cut into 1 cm steaks

steps: Pat the turkey steaks dry and season with salt and black pepper; lay a sage leaf and a slice of prosciutto on each piece and press.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the wine and butter and bubble 1 minute.
Return the turkey steaks with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the buttery sauce over.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Polpette Turkey Meatballs
steps: Mix the turkey with the egg, breadcrumbs, parmesan, parsley and half the garlic and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 16 balls.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 6 minutes, turning; they finish cooking in the sauce.
Cook the onion and garlic gently in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Add the passata and simmer the meatballs gently for 20 minutes, until the meat is no longer pink inside (74 °C / 165 °F).
Tear over the basil and serve with bread or pasta.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Bolognese-Style Turkey Ragù
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the onion and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the turkey and the carrot and celery and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (74 °C / 165 °F).
Stir in the wine, then the passata; simmer 30 minutes.
Toss with the pasta and parmesan.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: French Au Poivre Turkey Steaks

ingredients.name: Turkey breast, cut into 1 cm steaks

steps: Pat the turkey steaks dry and season with salt and the crushed peppercorns, pressed on both sides.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the shallots and garlic for 1 minute, then the brandy (careful, it can flame), then the cream; bubble 2 minutes.
Return the turkey steaks with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the peppery cream over.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: French Dijon Cream Turkey Steaks

ingredients.name: Turkey breast, cut into 1 cm steaks

steps: Pat the turkey steaks dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the shallots and garlic for 1 minute, then the wine and reduce by half, then the cream and mustard.
Return the turkey steaks with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Stir in the tarragon and spoon over.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: French Beurre Blanc Turkey Steaks

ingredients.name: Turkey breast, cut into 1 cm steaks

steps: Pat the turkey steaks dry and season with salt and white pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the shallots and garlic for 1 minute, then the wine and vinegar until almost gone, then whisk in the butter a cube at a time off the heat.
Return the turkey steaks with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the sauce over and scatter with chives.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: French Steak Haché Turkey Patties

ingredients.name: Black pepper, coarsely crushed (or green peppercorns)

steps: Mix the turkey with the egg yolk, mustard and half the shallots and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 8 patties or logs.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 8 minutes, turning, until no longer pink inside (74 °C / 165 °F).
Cook the shallots and garlic gently in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Stir together the cream and peppercorns and bubble 2 minutes.
Spoon the sauce over and serve with fries or salad.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: Spanish Al Ajillo Turkey Steaks

ingredients.name: Turkey breast, cut into 1 cm steaks

steps: Pat the turkey steaks dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the sliced garlic and chili gently until golden, then the wine.
Return the turkey steaks with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Scatter with parsley and serve with bread.
Serve with crusty bread or potatoes.

recipes.title: Spanish Albondigas en Salsa Turkey Meatballs
steps: Mix the turkey with the egg, breadcrumbs, paprika and half the garlic and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 16 balls.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 6 minutes, turning; they finish cooking in the sauce.
Cook the onion and garlic gently in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Add the wine and tomatoes and simmer the meatballs 20 minutes, until the meat is no longer pink inside (74 °C / 165 °F).
Scatter with parsley.
Serve with crusty bread or potatoes.

recipes.title: Portuguese Garlic Wine Turkey Steaks Bitoque-Style

ingredients.name: Turkey breast, cut into 1 cm steaks

steps: Pat the turkey steaks dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the garlic and bay leaves, then the wine; bubble 2 minutes.
Return the turkey steaks with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Serve each portion topped with a fried egg.

recipes.title: Greek Feta and Tomato Turkey Steaks

ingredients.name: Turkey breast, cut into 1 cm steaks

steps: Pat the turkey steaks dry and season with salt and the oregano.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the cherry tomatoes until they burst, then the olives.
Return the turkey steaks with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Crumble over the feta.
Serve with rice, potatoes or warm pitta.

recipes.title: Greek Keftedes Turkey Meatballs
steps: Mix the turkey with the egg, breadcrumbs, mint, oregano, onion and garlic and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 16 balls.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 8 minutes, turning, until no longer pink inside (74 °C / 165 °F).
Stir together the yogurt seasoned with salt and a little garlic as a dip.
Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Turkish Köfte Turkey Patties
steps: Mix the turkey with the egg, breadcrumbs, cumin, pepper, parsley, onion and garlic and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 8 patties or logs.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 8 minutes, turning, until no longer pink inside (74 °C / 165 °F).
Stir together the yogurt with a pinch of salt for serving.
Serve with flatbread, salad and the yogurt.

recipes.title: Moroccan Kefta Turkey Tagine
steps: Mix the turkey with the cumin, paprika, parsley and half the onion and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 8 patties or logs.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 6 minutes, turning; they finish cooking in the sauce.
Cook the onion, garlic and ginger gently in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes; simmer the meatballs 15 minutes, then crack in the eggs, cover and cook 6 minutes, until the meat is no longer pink inside (74 °C / 165 °F).
Serve with bread.

recipes.title: American Honey Garlic Turkey Steaks

ingredients.name: Turkey breast, cut into 1 cm steaks

steps: Pat the turkey steaks dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the garlic for 30 seconds, then the honey, soy sauce and vinegar; bubble until sticky.
Return the turkey steaks with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Turn to coat.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: American Creamy Tuscan-Style Turkey Steaks

ingredients.name: Turkey breast, cut into 1 cm steaks

steps: Pat the turkey steaks dry and season with salt and the Italian seasoning.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the sun-dried tomatoes and garlic, then the cream and parmesan, then the spinach until wilted.
Return the turkey steaks with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon over.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: American Sloppy Joe-Style Turkey Sandwiches
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the onion and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the turkey and the pepper and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (74 °C / 165 °F).
Stir in the ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, sugar and 100 ml water and simmer 10 minutes.
Pile onto toasted buns.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: British Peppercorn Turkey Steaks

ingredients.name: Turkey breast, cut into 1 cm steaks

steps: Pat the turkey steaks dry and season with salt and the crushed peppercorns.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until cooked through, with no pink in the middle (74 °C / 165 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the cream and mustard; bubble 2 minutes.
Return the turkey steaks with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon over and serve with chips or salad.
Serve with mashed potatoes and greens.

recipes.title: Thai Massaman Cod Curry
steps: Cook the garlic and chilies in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the curry paste for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk, potatoes, onion and 300 ml water and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Stir in the fish sauce, sugar and lime juice and scatter with peanuts. Taste for salt.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Red Cod Curry
steps: Cook the garlic and chilies in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the curry paste for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk and 200 ml water, adding the pepper and beans for the last 10 minutes and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Season with the fish sauce and sugar and stir in the basil. Taste for salt.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Green Cod Curry
steps: Cook the garlic and chilies in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the curry paste for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk, lime leaves and 200 ml water, adding the eggplant and zucchini for the last 15 minutes and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Season with the fish sauce and sugar. Taste for salt.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Lemongrass Salmon Traybake
steps: Mix the lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce, sugar and soy sauce with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the salmon and leave to marinate 15 minutes (no longer, or the acid starts to cook it) in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Spread on a lined tray in one layer.
Roast for about 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Rest 5 minutes. Scatter with coriander and serve with lime wedges.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Grilled Thai Gai Yang-Style Salmon
steps: Mix the fish sauce, soy sauce, sugar, coriander, pepper and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the salmon and leave to marinate 15 minutes (no longer, or the acid starts to cook it) in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Spread on a rack over a lined tray.
Roast for about 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with sweet chili sauce for dipping.

recipes.title: Thai Garlic Pepper Salmon
steps: Pat the salmon dry and season with salt and the white pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook skin side down 4 minutes, then 2 to 3 minutes on the other side, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and chilies for 1 minute, then the garlic for 1 minute, then add the oyster sauce, fish sauce, sugar and 4 tbsp water.
Return the salmon with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the glossy garlic sauce over.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Garlic Pepper Cod
steps: Pat the cod dry and season with salt and the white pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once gently, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and chilies for 1 minute, then the garlic for 1 minute, then add the oyster sauce, fish sauce, sugar and 4 tbsp water.
Return the cod with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the glossy garlic sauce over.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Red-Braised Cod Hong Shao

ingredients.name: Soy sauce (1 tbsp dark if you have it)

steps: Cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the star anise and cinnamon for 1 minute.
Add the soy sauces, wine, sugar and water to just cover and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Uncover for the last 15 minutes and boil until the sauce is sticky. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Five-Spice Braised Cod
steps: Cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the five-spice for 1 minute.
Add the soy sauce, hoisin, wine, carrots and 400 ml water and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Reduce the sauce until it coats the meat. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Roast Chinese Char Siu-Style Salmon
steps: Mix the hoisin, honey, soy sauce, five-spice, wine and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the salmon and leave to marinate 15 minutes (no longer, or the acid starts to cook it) in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Set on a rack over a lined tray and brush with more marinade halfway.
Roast for about 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Rest 5 minutes. Slice and spoon over the pan juices.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Honey Soy Salmon Traybake
steps: Mix the soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, ginger and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the salmon and leave to marinate 15 minutes (no longer, or the acid starts to cook it) in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Spread on a lined tray.
Roast for about 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Rest 5 minutes. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and the green spring onions.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Ginger Scallion Salmon
steps: Pat the salmon dry and season with salt and white pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook skin side down 4 minutes, then 2 to 3 minutes on the other side, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.

Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 1 minute, then the ginger and spring onions for 1 minute, then add the soy sauce, wine and 4 tbsp water.
Return the salmon with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Drizzle with the sesame oil.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Ginger Scallion Cod
steps: Pat the cod dry and season with salt and white pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once gently, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.

Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 1 minute, then the ginger and spring onions for 1 minute, then add the soy sauce, wine and 4 tbsp water.
Return the cod with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Drizzle with the sesame oil.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Sichuan Spicy Bean Paste Braised Cod
steps: Cook the garlic and ginger in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the chili bean paste and star anise for 1 minute.
Add the soy sauce, daikon and water to just cover and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Scatter with Sichuan pepper and coriander. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Sichuan Mala Salmon
steps: Pat the salmon dry and season with salt and the ground Sichuan pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook skin side down 4 minutes, then 2 to 3 minutes on the other side, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the chili oil, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and 3 tbsp water.
Return the salmon with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the numbing chili sauce over.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Sichuan Mala Cod
steps: Pat the cod dry and season with salt and the ground Sichuan pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once gently, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the chili oil, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and 3 tbsp water.
Return the cod with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the numbing chili sauce over.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Nikujaga-Style Cod Stew
steps: Cook the garlic and ginger in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the onion for 1 minute.
Add the dashi, soy sauce, mirin, sugar, potatoes and carrots and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Let it sit 10 minutes so the potatoes soak up the sauce. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed short-grain rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Japanese Curry Cod Stew
steps: Cook the garlic and ginger in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the onions until golden for 1 minute.
Add 700 ml water, the carrots, potatoes and apple, then stir in the curry roux for the last 10 minutes and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Serve over rice. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Japanese Miso Salmon Bake
steps: Mix the miso, mirin, sugar and sake with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the salmon and leave to marinate 15 minutes (no longer, or the acid starts to cook it) in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Spread on a lined tray.
Roast for about 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Rest 5 minutes. Sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve with steamed short-grain rice.

recipes.title: Grilled Japanese Yuzu Kosho-Style Salmon

ingredients.name: Yuzu kosho (or lemon zest and green chili)

steps: Mix the yuzu kosho, soy sauce and mirin with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the salmon and leave to marinate 15 minutes (no longer, or the acid starts to cook it) in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Lay on a rack over a lined tray.
Roast for about 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Japanese Teriyaki Salmon
steps: Pat the salmon dry and season with salt and a pinch of salt only (the sauce is salty).
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook skin side down 4 minutes, then 2 to 3 minutes on the other side, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the soy sauce, mirin, sake and sugar and let it bubble 2 minutes until syrupy.
Return the salmon with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Turn to coat and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve with steamed short-grain rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Teriyaki Cod
steps: Pat the cod dry and season with salt and a pinch of salt only (the sauce is salty).
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once gently, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the soy sauce, mirin, sake and sugar and let it bubble 2 minutes until syrupy.
Return the cod with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Turn to coat and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve with steamed short-grain rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Butter Ponzu Salmon

ingredients.name: Ponzu (or soy sauce with lemon juice)

steps: Pat the salmon dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook skin side down 4 minutes, then 2 to 3 minutes on the other side, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the ponzu and butter and swirl until glossy.
Return the salmon with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Scatter with the spring onions.
Serve with steamed short-grain rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Butter Ponzu Cod

ingredients.name: Ponzu (or soy sauce with lemon juice)

steps: Pat the cod dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once gently, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the ponzu and butter and swirl until glossy.
Return the cod with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Scatter with the spring onions.
Serve with steamed short-grain rice.

recipes.title: Korean Galbi Jjim-Style Braised Cod
steps: Cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in black pepper for 1 minute.
Add the soy sauce, sugar, grated pear, mushrooms and water to just cover, adding the carrot and daikon for the last 40 minutes and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Reduce the sauce until glossy and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Korean Dakdoritang-Style Cod Stew
steps: Cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the gochujang and chili flakes for 1 minute.
Add the soy sauce, sugar, potatoes, carrots, onion and 600 ml water and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Scatter with the green spring onions. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Korean Gochujang Salmon Traybake
steps: Mix the gochujang, honey, soy sauce, sesame oil, vinegar and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the salmon and leave to marinate 15 minutes (no longer, or the acid starts to cook it) in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Spread on a lined tray and turn once.
Roast for about 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Rest 5 minutes. Sprinkle with the green spring onions and serve with lettuce leaves for wrapping.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Grilled Korean Galbi-Style Salmon
steps: Mix the soy sauce, sugar, grated pear, sesame oil and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the salmon and leave to marinate 15 minutes (no longer, or the acid starts to cook it) in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Lay on a rack over a lined tray.
Roast for about 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Rest 5 minutes. Sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Korean Soy Garlic Salmon
steps: Pat the salmon dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook skin side down 4 minutes, then 2 to 3 minutes on the other side, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.

Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 1 minute, then the garlic for 1 minute, then add the soy sauce, honey, vinegar and chili flakes and bubble until sticky.
Return the salmon with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Turn to coat.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Korean Soy Garlic Cod
steps: Pat the cod dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once gently, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.

Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 1 minute, then the garlic for 1 minute, then add the soy sauce, honey, vinegar and chili flakes and bubble until sticky.
Return the cod with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Turn to coat.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Caramel Cod Kho
steps: Cook the garlic and shallots in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the sugar, cooked dry in the pot until dark amber, then for 1 minute.
Add the fish sauce, coconut water, pepper and eggs and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Reduce until the sauce is dark and sticky. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice or rice noodles with herbs.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Lemongrass Cod Stew
steps: Cook the garlic and shallots in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the curry powder and lemongrass for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk, fish sauce, carrots, sweet potato and 300 ml water and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Serve with bread or rice noodles. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Grilled Vietnamese Lemongrass Salmon
steps: Mix the lemongrass, garlic, shallots, fish sauce and sugar with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the salmon and leave to marinate 15 minutes (no longer, or the acid starts to cook it) in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Lay on a rack over a lined tray.
Roast for about 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with mint and lime wedges.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Nuoc Cham Salmon
steps: Pat the salmon dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook skin side down 4 minutes, then 2 to 3 minutes on the other side, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and shallots for 1 minute, then the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the fish sauce, sugar, lime juice, chili and 3 tbsp water.
Return the salmon with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon over and scatter with mint.
Serve with rice or rice noodles with herbs.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Nuoc Cham Cod
steps: Pat the cod dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once gently, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and shallots for 1 minute, then the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the fish sauce, sugar, lime juice, chili and 3 tbsp water.
Return the cod with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon over and scatter with mint.
Serve with rice or rice noodles with herbs.

recipes.title: Indian Butter Cod Curry
steps: Cook the onions, garlic and ginger in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the garam masala, cumin and chili for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and 150 ml water and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Stir in the cream, butter and fenugreek and simmer 5 minutes. Taste for salt.
Serve with basmati rice or naan.

recipes.title: Indian Rogan Josh-Style Cod Curry
steps: Cook the onions, garlic and ginger in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the chili, fennel, ginger, cardamom and cinnamon for 1 minute.
Add the yogurt, a spoonful at a time, and 400 ml water and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Simmer uncovered until the sauce is thick and red. Taste for salt.
Serve with basmati rice or naan.

recipes.title: Indian Korma Cod Curry
steps: Cook the onions, garlic and ginger in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the cardamom, coriander and turmeric for 1 minute.
Add the yogurt, almonds, coconut milk and 200 ml water and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Scatter with toasted almonds. Taste for salt.
Serve with basmati rice or naan.

recipes.title: Indian Vindaloo-Style Cod Curry
steps: Cook the onions, garlic and ginger in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the chili, cayenne, cumin and mustard seeds for 1 minute.
Add the vinegar, tomatoes and 250 ml water and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Let it rest 10 minutes; it tastes even better the next day. Taste for salt.
Serve with basmati rice or naan.

recipes.title: Indian Saag Cod Curry
steps: Cook the onions, garlic and ginger in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the garam masala, cumin, turmeric and chili for 1 minute.
Add 300 ml water, then the spinach for the last 10 minutes; blend half the sauce if you like it smooth and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Stir in the cream. Taste for salt.
Serve with basmati rice or naan.

recipes.title: Roast Indian Tandoori-Style Salmon
steps: Mix the yogurt, garlic, ginger, spices and lemon juice with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the salmon and leave to marinate 15 minutes (no longer, or the acid starts to cook it) in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Lay on a rack over a lined tray.
Roast for about 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with the raw onion rings and lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Indian Tikka Salmon Skewers
steps: Mix the yogurt, garlic, ginger and spices with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the salmon and leave to marinate 15 minutes (no longer, or the acid starts to cook it) in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Thread on skewers with the peppers and onion and lay on a lined tray.
Roast for about 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with mint yogurt.

recipes.title: Indian Masala Salmon
steps: Pat the salmon dry and season with salt and the garam masala, turmeric and chili.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook skin side down 4 minutes, then 2 to 3 minutes on the other side, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onions, garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the onions, garlic and ginger for 5 minutes, then the tomatoes and 4 tbsp water until jammy.
Return the salmon with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Scatter with coriander.
Serve with basmati rice or naan.

recipes.title: Indian Masala Cod
steps: Pat the cod dry and season with salt and the garam masala, turmeric and chili.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once gently, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onions, garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the onions, garlic and ginger for 5 minutes, then the tomatoes and 4 tbsp water until jammy.
Return the cod with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Scatter with coriander.
Serve with basmati rice or naan.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Black Cod Curry
steps: Cook the onion, garlic, ginger and curry leaves in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the curry powder, pepper and cinnamon for 1 minute.
Add the tamarind and 400 ml water, then the coconut milk for the last 20 minutes and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Simmer until dark and thick. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Coconut Cod Curry
steps: Cook the onion, garlic, ginger and curry leaves in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the curry powder, turmeric and chili for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk and 200 ml water and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Finish with the lime juice. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Devilled Salmon
steps: Pat the salmon dry and season with salt and the chili flakes.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook skin side down 4 minutes, then 2 to 3 minutes on the other side, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion, garlic, ginger and curry leaves for 1 minute, then the onion and pepper for 3 minutes, then the ketchup, chili sauce, soy sauce and 3 tbsp water.
Return the salmon with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Toss to coat.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Devilled Cod
steps: Pat the cod dry and season with salt and the chili flakes.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once gently, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion, garlic, ginger and curry leaves for 1 minute, then the onion and pepper for 3 minutes, then the ketchup, chili sauce, soy sauce and 3 tbsp water.
Return the cod with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Toss to coat.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Indonesian Rendang-Style Braised Cod
steps: Cook the shallots, garlic and chilies in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the ginger, coriander and turmeric for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk, lemongrass, sugar and 200 ml water; uncover for the last hour and stir often until almost dry and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Stir in the toasted coconut and fry a few minutes more until dark. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Indonesian Opor-Style Cod Curry
steps: Cook the shallots, garlic and chilies in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the coriander, cumin and turmeric for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk, lemongrass, lime leaves and 200 ml water and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Scatter with fried shallots if you have them. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Indonesian Satay Salmon Skewers
steps: Mix the kecap manis, coriander, shallots and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the salmon and leave to marinate 15 minutes (no longer, or the acid starts to cook it) in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Thread on skewers and lay on a lined tray; meanwhile simmer the peanut butter, coconut milk, lime juice and chili flakes into a sauce.
Roast for about 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with the peanut sauce.

recipes.title: Malaysian Kapitan-Style Cod Curry
steps: Cook the shallots, garlic and ginger in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the chili garlic sauce, lemongrass and turmeric for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk, tamarind and 200 ml water and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Season with sugar and salt. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Malaysian Kurma-Style Cod Curry
steps: Cook the shallots, garlic and ginger in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the curry powder, cinnamon and cardamom for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk, potatoes and 200 ml water and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Simmer until the potatoes are soft. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Grilled Malaysian Ayam Percik-Style Salmon
steps: Mix the coconut milk, lemongrass, turmeric, chili garlic sauce and sugar with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the salmon and leave to marinate 15 minutes (no longer, or the acid starts to cook it) in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Lay on a rack over a lined tray, basting with marinade twice.
Roast for about 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with cucumber.

recipes.title: Filipino Adobo Braised Cod
steps: Cook the onion and garlic in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the peppercorns and bay leaves for 1 minute.
Add the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and 200 ml water; let it boil 2 minutes before stirring so the vinegar mellows and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Reduce the sauce until it coats the meat. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Filipino Caldereta-Style Cod Stew
steps: Cook the onion and garlic in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in black pepper for 1 minute.
Add the tomato sauce and 300 ml water, adding the potatoes and carrots for the last 30 minutes and the pepper for the last 10 and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Stir in the pate and olives. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Filipino Sinigang-Style Cod Sour Soup
steps: Cook the onion and garlic in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in black pepper for 1 minute.
Add 1.5 litres water, the tamarind and tomatoes, adding the radish and beans for the last 10 minutes and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Stir in the spinach and fish sauce. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Grilled Filipino Inasal-Style Salmon
steps: Mix the lemongrass, vinegar, citrus juice, annatto and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the salmon and leave to marinate 15 minutes (no longer, or the acid starts to cook it) in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Lay on a rack over a lined tray, basting with the butter.
Roast for about 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with soy-vinegar dip.

recipes.title: Filipino Bistek-Style Salmon
steps: Pat the salmon dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook skin side down 4 minutes, then 2 to 3 minutes on the other side, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the onion rings for 3 minutes, then the soy sauce, lemon juice and 4 tbsp water.
Return the salmon with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the onions and sauce over.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Filipino Bistek-Style Cod
steps: Pat the cod dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once gently, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the onion rings for 3 minutes, then the soy sauce, lemon juice and 4 tbsp water.
Return the cod with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the onions and sauce over.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Mexican Chipotle Cod Tinga
steps: Cook the onion and garlic in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the cumin and oregano for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, chipotles and 200 ml water; shred the meat at the end and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Serve in tortillas with avocado and crema. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Mexican Red Chile Cod Guisado

ingredients.name: Dried guajillo chilies, seeded and soaked
Dried ancho chilies, seeded and soaked

steps: Cook the onion and garlic in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the cumin and oregano for 1 minute.
Add the chilies blended with the stock and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Serve with rice and beans. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Mexican Salsa Verde Cod Guisado
steps: Cook the onion and garlic in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in black pepper for 1 minute.
Add the tomatillos, jalapeños and coriander blended with the stock and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Scatter with more coriander. Taste for salt.
Serve with warm tortillas and rice.

recipes.title: Mexican Barbacoa-Style Braised Cod
steps: Cook the onion and garlic in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the cumin and oregano for 1 minute.
Add the chipotles blended with the vinegar and 300 ml water, plus the bay leaves; shred the meat at the end and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Squeeze over the lime and serve in tortillas. Taste for salt.
Serve with warm tortillas and rice.

recipes.title: Roast Mexican Achiote Salmon
steps: Mix the achiote paste, citrus juice, oregano and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the salmon and leave to marinate 15 minutes (no longer, or the acid starts to cook it) in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Lay in a roasting dish with the marinade.
Roast for about 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with quick-pickled red onion.

recipes.title: Grilled Mexican Carne Asada-Style Salmon
steps: Mix the citrus juice, cumin, chili powder, coriander and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the salmon and leave to marinate 15 minutes (no longer, or the acid starts to cook it) in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Lay on a rack over a lined tray.
Roast for about 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Rest 5 minutes. Slice thinly and serve in tortillas with salsa.
Serve with warm tortillas and rice.

recipes.title: Roast Mexican Al Pastor-Style Salmon
steps: Mix the soaked chilies, chipotles, pineapple juice, vinegar, cumin and garlic, blended with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the salmon and leave to marinate 15 minutes (no longer, or the acid starts to cook it) in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Lay on a lined tray with the pineapple slices around it.
Roast for about 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Rest 5 minutes. Chop with the pineapple and serve in tortillas.
Serve with warm tortillas and rice.

recipes.title: Mexican Fajita Salmon
steps: Pat the salmon dry and season with salt and the chili powder, cumin and paprika.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook skin side down 4 minutes, then 2 to 3 minutes on the other side, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the peppers and onion until charred at the edges, then a splash of water.
Return the salmon with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Slice the meat, squeeze over the lime and pile into tortillas.
Serve with warm tortillas and rice.

recipes.title: Mexican Fajita Cod
steps: Pat the cod dry and season with salt and the chili powder, cumin and paprika.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once gently, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the peppers and onion until charred at the edges, then a splash of water.
Return the cod with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Slice the meat, squeeze over the lime and pile into tortillas.
Serve with warm tortillas and rice.

recipes.title: Mexican Mole-Style Salmon
steps: Pat the salmon dry and season with salt and ground cumin.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook skin side down 4 minutes, then 2 to 3 minutes on the other side, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
