Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the mole paste and stock and simmer until thick, then melt in the chocolate.
Return the salmon with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the sauce over and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve with warm tortillas and rice.

recipes.title: Mexican Mole-Style Cod
steps: Pat the cod dry and season with salt and ground cumin.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once gently, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the mole paste and stock and simmer until thick, then melt in the chocolate.
Return the cod with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the sauce over and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve with warm tortillas and rice.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Chili con Carne Cod Stew
steps: Cook the onion and garlic in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the chili powder, cumin and oregano for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans and stock and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Serve with cheese and sour cream. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Cumin Lime Salmon Traybake
steps: Mix the cumin, chili powder, lime juice and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the salmon and leave to marinate 15 minutes (no longer, or the acid starts to cook it) in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Spread on a tray with the peppers and onion.
Roast for about 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with tortillas and salsa.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Queso Salmon
steps: Pat the salmon dry and season with salt and the chili powder.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook skin side down 4 minutes, then 2 to 3 minutes on the other side, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the jalapeño, then the milk and cornstarch until thick; melt in the cheese off the heat.
Return the salmon with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Pour the queso over.
Serve with rice and beans.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Queso Cod
steps: Pat the cod dry and season with salt and the chili powder.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once gently, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the jalapeño, then the milk and cornstarch until thick; melt in the cheese off the heat.
Return the cod with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Pour the queso over.
Serve with rice and beans.

recipes.title: Jamaican Curry Cod Curry
steps: Cook the onion, garlic, spring onions and scotch bonnet in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the curry powder, allspice and thyme for 1 minute.
Add 500 ml water and the potatoes and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Simmer uncovered until thick. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice and peas.

recipes.title: Jamaican Brown Stew Cod Stew
steps: Cook the onion, garlic, spring onions and scotch bonnet in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the allspice and thyme for 1 minute.
Add the browning sauce, ketchup and 400 ml water, with the carrots and pepper for the last 15 minutes and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Serve with rice. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Roast Jamaican Jerk Salmon
steps: Mix the jerk seasoning, allspice, sugar, lime, soy sauce, spring onions, garlic and scotch bonnet blended with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the salmon and leave to marinate 15 minutes (no longer, or the acid starts to cook it) in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Lay on a rack over a lined tray.
Roast for about 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Jamaican Escovitch Salmon

ingredients.name: Red bell pepper, cut into thin strips

steps: Pat the salmon dry and season with salt and the allspice.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook skin side down 4 minutes, then 2 to 3 minutes on the other side, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.

Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion, garlic, spring onions and scotch bonnet for 1 minute, then the onion, carrot, pepper and scotch bonnet for 2 minutes, then the vinegar and sugar for 1 minute.
Return the salmon with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Pour the hot pickled vegetables over.
Serve with rice and peas.

recipes.title: Jamaican Escovitch Cod

ingredients.name: Red bell pepper, cut into thin strips

steps: Pat the cod dry and season with salt and the allspice.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once gently, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.

Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion, garlic, spring onions and scotch bonnet for 1 minute, then the onion, carrot, pepper and scotch bonnet for 2 minutes, then the vinegar and sugar for 1 minute.
Return the cod with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Pour the hot pickled vegetables over.
Serve with rice and peas.

recipes.title: Cuban Ropa Vieja-Style Cod Stew
steps: Cook the onion, pepper and garlic in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the cumin and oregano for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, wine, bay leaves and 300 ml water; shred the meat at the end and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Stir in the olives. Taste for salt.
Serve with white rice and black beans.

recipes.title: Roast Cuban Mojo Salmon
steps: Mix the citrus juice, cumin, oregano and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the salmon and leave to marinate 15 minutes (no longer, or the acid starts to cook it) in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Lay in a roasting dish on the onion rings.
Roast for about 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Rest 5 minutes. Spoon over the pan juices.
Serve with white rice and black beans.

recipes.title: Cuban Mojo Salmon
steps: Pat the salmon dry and season with salt and the cumin and oregano.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook skin side down 4 minutes, then 2 to 3 minutes on the other side, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion, pepper and garlic for 1 minute, then the garlic for 1 minute, then the citrus juice; bubble 2 minutes.
Return the salmon with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the garlicky mojo over.
Serve with white rice and black beans.

recipes.title: Cuban Mojo Cod
steps: Pat the cod dry and season with salt and the cumin and oregano.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once gently, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion, pepper and garlic for 1 minute, then the garlic for 1 minute, then the citrus juice; bubble 2 minutes.
Return the cod with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the garlicky mojo over.
Serve with white rice and black beans.

recipes.title: Roast Peruvian Pollo a la Brasa-Style Salmon
steps: Mix the soy sauce, lime, cumin, paprika, oregano and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the salmon and leave to marinate 15 minutes (no longer, or the acid starts to cook it) in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Lay on a rack over a lined tray.
Roast for about 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with green sauce and fries.

recipes.title: Peruvian Anticucho-Style Salmon Skewers

ingredients.name: Aji panca paste (or 2 tsp paprika and 1 tsp chili powder)

steps: Mix the vinegar, chili paste, cumin, oregano and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the salmon and leave to marinate 15 minutes (no longer, or the acid starts to cook it) in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Thread on skewers and lay on a lined tray.
Roast for about 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with boiled potatoes and corn.

recipes.title: Peruvian Seco-Style Cod Stew

ingredients.name: Green chili (aji amarillo if you can find it)

steps: Cook the onion and garlic in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in ground cumin for 1 minute.
Add the coriander blended with the chili and beer, then the carrots for the last 30 minutes and the peas for the last 5 and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Serve with rice and beans. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Brazilian Moqueca-Style Cod Stew

ingredients.name: Palm oil (or olive oil with 1 tsp paprika)

steps: Cook the onion and garlic in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the paprika for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk, pepper and tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Stir in the lime juice and coriander. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice and black beans.

recipes.title: Brazilian Feijoada-Style Cod Stew
steps: Cook the onion and garlic in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in black pepper for 1 minute.
Add the beans, sausage, bay leaves and stock and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Serve with rice, greens and orange slices. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Grilled Brazilian Churrasco-Style Salmon
steps: Mix the coarse salt and garlic only with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the salmon and leave to marinate 15 minutes (no longer, or the acid starts to cook it) in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Mix the onion, tomatoes, parsley and vinegar as a vinaigrette salsa.
Roast for about 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Rest 5 minutes. Slice and serve with the salsa.
Serve with rice and black beans.

recipes.title: Brazilian Acebolado Salmon
steps: Pat the salmon dry and season with salt and the paprika.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook skin side down 4 minutes, then 2 to 3 minutes on the other side, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the onion rings in the butter until soft and golden, then the vinegar.
Return the salmon with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Pile the onions on top.
Serve with rice and black beans.

recipes.title: Brazilian Acebolado Cod
steps: Pat the cod dry and season with salt and the paprika.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once gently, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the onion rings in the butter until soft and golden, then the vinegar.
Return the cod with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Pile the onions on top.
Serve with rice and black beans.

recipes.title: Grilled Argentine Chimichurri Salmon
steps: Mix salt, a little of the oregano and the oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the salmon and leave to marinate 15 minutes (no longer, or the acid starts to cook it) in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Mix the parsley, garlic, the rest of the oregano, chili, vinegar and oil as chimichurri.
Roast for about 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Rest 5 minutes. Slice and spoon over the chimichurri.
Serve with roast potatoes or a green salad.

recipes.title: Argentine Salsa Criolla Salmon
steps: Pat the salmon dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook skin side down 4 minutes, then 2 to 3 minutes on the other side, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Meanwhile, off the heat, mix the onion, pepper, tomatoes, vinegar and oil for the salsa while the meat rests.
Spoon the salsa over.
Serve with roast potatoes or a green salad.

recipes.title: Argentine Salsa Criolla Cod
steps: Pat the cod dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once gently, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Meanwhile, off the heat, mix the onion, pepper, tomatoes, vinegar and oil for the salsa while the meat rests.
Spoon the salsa over.
Serve with roast potatoes or a green salad.

recipes.title: Argentine Carbonada-Style Cod Stew
steps: Cook the garlic in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in paprika for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and stock, adding the vegetables and fruit for the last 30 minutes and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Serve in bowls. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Italian Cacciatore Braised Cod
steps: Cook the onion and garlic in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the oregano and rosemary for 1 minute.
Add the wine (boil 1 minute), tomatoes, pepper and mushrooms and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Stir in the olives. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Ragù Braised Cod
steps: Cook the onion and garlic in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in black pepper for 1 minute.

Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).

Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Peperonata Braised Cod
steps: Cook the onion and garlic in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in black pepper for 1 minute.

Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

Stir in the olives and basil. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Roast Italian Porchetta-Style Salmon
steps: Mix the fennel seeds, rosemary, lemon zest, chili and garlic with oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the salmon and leave to marinate 15 minutes (no longer, or the acid starts to cook it) in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Lay in a roasting dish and pour the wine around.
Roast for about 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).

Roast for about 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Rest 5 minutes. Spoon over the pan juices.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook skin side down 4 minutes, then 2 to 3 minutes on the other side, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the stock, lemon juice and capers and bubble 2 minutes, then swirl in the butter.
Return the salmon with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Scatter with parsley.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Piccata Cod

Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the stock, lemon juice and capers and bubble 2 minutes, then swirl in the butter.
Return the cod with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Scatter with parsley.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Marsala Salmon
steps: Pat the salmon dry and season with salt and black pepper; dust lightly with flour.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook skin side down 4 minutes, then 2 to 3 minutes on the other side, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the mushrooms in the butter until golden, then the Marsala and stock and reduce by half.
Return the salmon with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the mushrooms and sauce over.

recipes.title: Italian Marsala Cod
steps: Pat the cod dry and season with salt and black pepper; dust lightly with flour.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once gently, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the mushrooms in the butter until golden, then the Marsala and stock and reduce by half.
Return the cod with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the mushrooms and sauce over.

recipes.title: Italian Saltimbocca-Style Salmon
steps: Pat the salmon dry and season with salt and black pepper; lay a sage leaf and a slice of prosciutto on each piece and press.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook skin side down 4 minutes, then 2 to 3 minutes on the other side, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the wine and butter and bubble 1 minute.
Return the salmon with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the buttery sauce over.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Saltimbocca-Style Cod
steps: Pat the cod dry and season with salt and black pepper; lay a sage leaf and a slice of prosciutto on each piece and press.

steps: Cook the shallots and garlic in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the thyme and flour for 1 minute.
Add the wine, bay leaves and 250 ml stock or water; fry the bacon, mushrooms and onions separately and add for the last 20 minutes and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Scatter with parsley. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: French Provençal Braised Cod
steps: Cook the shallots and garlic in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the herbes de Provence for 1 minute.
Add the wine, tomatoes and fennel and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Stir in the olives. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: French Cider and Mustard Braised Cod
steps: Cook the shallots and garlic in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the thyme for 1 minute.
Add the cider and mustard, adding the apples for the last 15 minutes and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Stir in the crème fraîche. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: Roast French Dijon Herb Salmon
steps: Mix the mustard, herbs and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the salmon and leave to marinate 15 minutes (no longer, or the acid starts to cook it) in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Lay on a lined tray and press on the breadcrumbs mixed with butter.
Roast for about 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with the pan juices.

recipes.title: French Au Poivre Salmon
steps: Pat the salmon dry and season with salt and the crushed peppercorns, pressed on both sides.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook skin side down 4 minutes, then 2 to 3 minutes on the other side, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the shallots and garlic for 1 minute, then the brandy (careful, it can flame), then the cream; bubble 2 minutes.
Return the salmon with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the peppery cream over.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: French Au Poivre Cod
steps: Pat the cod dry and season with salt and the crushed peppercorns, pressed on both sides.

Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the shallots and garlic for 1 minute, then the brandy (careful, it can flame), then the cream; bubble 2 minutes.
Return the cod with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the peppery cream over.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook skin side down 4 minutes, then 2 to 3 minutes on the other side, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the shallots and garlic for 1 minute, then the wine and reduce by half, then the cream and mustard.
Return the salmon with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Stir in the tarragon and spoon over.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: French Dijon Cream Cod
steps: Pat the cod dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once gently, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.

Return the cod with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Stir in the tarragon and spoon over.

Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook skin side down 4 minutes, then 2 to 3 minutes on the other side, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the shallots and garlic for 1 minute, then the wine and vinegar until almost gone, then whisk in the butter a cube at a time off the heat.
Return the salmon with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the sauce over and scatter with chives.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: French Beurre Blanc Cod
steps: Pat the cod dry and season with salt and white pepper.

steps: Cook the onion and garlic in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the smoked paprika for 1 minute.
Add the chorizo, tomatoes, chickpeas and 300 ml water, with the spinach at the end and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Drizzle with olive oil. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread or potatoes.

recipes.title: Spanish Sherry and Olive Braised Cod

Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Stir in the olives. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread or potatoes.

recipes.title: Spanish Saffron and Almond Cod Pepitoria-Style
steps: Cook the onion and garlic in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the saffron for 1 minute.
Add the wine and stock; at the end blend the almonds and egg yolks with some sauce and stir back in and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Chop the egg whites over the top. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread or potatoes.

recipes.title: Spanish Pimentón Salmon Traybake
steps: Mix the smoked paprika, lemon juice, garlic and oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the salmon and leave to marinate 15 minutes (no longer, or the acid starts to cook it) in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Spread on a tray with the potatoes, pepper and onion (start the potatoes 15 minutes earlier).
Roast for about 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Rest 5 minutes. Scatter with parsley.
Serve with crusty bread or potatoes.

recipes.title: Spanish Al Ajillo Salmon

Simmer uncovered until the sauce is reduced and lemony. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice, potatoes or warm pitta.

ingredients.name: Tomato paste (or Turkish red pepper paste)

steps: Mix the yogurt, pepper paste, cumin and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the salmon and leave to marinate 15 minutes (no longer, or the acid starts to cook it) in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Thread on skewers and lay on a lined tray.
Roast for about 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with the onion tossed with sumac.

recipes.title: Moroccan Apricot Cod Tagine
steps: Cook the onion, garlic and ginger in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the ras el hanout and cinnamon for 1 minute.
Add the apricots, chickpeas, honey and 500 ml water and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Scatter with almonds. Taste for salt.
Serve with couscous.

recipes.title: Moroccan Preserved Lemon and Olive Cod Tagine

ingredients.name: Preserved lemons, chopped (or 1 lemon, zested and juiced)

steps: Cook the onion, garlic and ginger in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the turmeric and ginger for 1 minute.
Add the preserved lemon and 400 ml water and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Stir in the olives and coriander. Taste for salt.
Serve with couscous.

recipes.title: Roast Moroccan Chermoula Salmon
steps: Mix the herbs, cumin, paprika, lemon and garlic blended with oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the salmon and leave to marinate 15 minutes (no longer, or the acid starts to cook it) in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Lay on a lined tray.
Roast for about 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: American Pot Roast-Style Braised Cod
steps: Cook the onion and garlic in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the thyme and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Add the stock, with the carrots and potatoes for the last hour and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Thicken the gravy if you like and serve. Taste for salt.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: American BBQ Salmon Traybake
steps: Mix the paprika, sugar, garlic powder and half the sauce with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the salmon and leave to marinate 15 minutes (no longer, or the acid starts to cook it) in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Spread on a lined tray, brushing with the rest of the sauce for the last 10 minutes.
Roast for about 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with coleslaw.

recipes.title: Roast American Maple Mustard Salmon
steps: Mix the maple, mustard, vinegar and rosemary with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the salmon and leave to marinate 15 minutes (no longer, or the acid starts to cook it) in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Lay on a lined tray.
Roast for about 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Rest 5 minutes. Spoon over the pan juices.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: American Honey Garlic Salmon
steps: Pat the salmon dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook skin side down 4 minutes, then 2 to 3 minutes on the other side, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the garlic for 30 seconds, then the honey, soy sauce and vinegar; bubble until sticky.
Return the salmon with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Turn to coat.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: American Honey Garlic Cod
steps: Pat the cod dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once gently, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the garlic for 30 seconds, then the honey, soy sauce and vinegar; bubble until sticky.
Return the cod with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Turn to coat.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: American Creamy Tuscan-Style Salmon
steps: Pat the salmon dry and season with salt and the Italian seasoning.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook skin side down 4 minutes, then 2 to 3 minutes on the other side, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the sun-dried tomatoes and garlic, then the cream and parmesan, then the spinach until wilted.
Return the salmon with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon over.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: American Creamy Tuscan-Style Cod
steps: Pat the cod dry and season with salt and the Italian seasoning.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once gently, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the sun-dried tomatoes and garlic, then the cream and parmesan, then the spinach until wilted.
Return the cod with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon over.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: British Ale Cod Stew
steps: Cook the onion and garlic in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the flour and thyme for 1 minute.
Add the ale, Worcestershire sauce, bay leaves, carrots and 200 ml stock and simmer 15 minutes so the flavours come together.
Season the cod with salt, nestle it into the sauce, cover and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Serve with mash or crusty bread. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: British Honey Mustard Salmon Traybake
steps: Mix the mustard, honey, thyme and oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the salmon and leave to marinate 15 minutes (no longer, or the acid starts to cook it) in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Spread on a tray with the potatoes and parsnips (start the vegetables 15 minutes earlier).
Roast for about 12 minutes, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F).
Rest 5 minutes. Spoon over the sticky juices.
Serve with mashed potatoes and greens.

recipes.title: British Peppercorn Salmon
steps: Pat the salmon dry and season with salt and the crushed peppercorns.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook skin side down 4 minutes, then 2 to 3 minutes on the other side, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the cream and mustard; bubble 2 minutes.
Return the salmon with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon over and serve with chips or salad.
Serve with mashed potatoes and greens.

recipes.title: British Peppercorn Cod
steps: Pat the cod dry and season with salt and the crushed peppercorns.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once gently, until the fish flakes easily (63 °C / 145 °F). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the cream and mustard; bubble 2 minutes.
Return the cod with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon over and serve with chips or salad.
Serve with mashed potatoes and greens.

recipes.title: Thai Holy Basil Shrimp Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: Basil leaves (Thai holy basil if you can find it)

steps: Pat the shrimp dry and toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
For the sauce, stir together the oyster sauce, fish sauce, sugar and 3 tbsp water.
Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the shrimp in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until pink and opaque all the way through; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the onion with the garlic and chilies for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the shrimp with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Turn off the heat and stir in the basil until it wilts.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Cashew Shrimp Stir-Fry
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
For the sauce, stir together the oyster sauce, soy sauce, sugar and 3 tbsp water.
Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the shrimp in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until pink and opaque all the way through; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the pepper and the white parts of the spring onions with the garlic and chilies for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the shrimp with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Toss in the cashews and green spring onion.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Ginger Shrimp Stir-Fry
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
For the sauce, stir together the oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce and 3 tbsp water.
Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the shrimp in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until pink and opaque all the way through; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the ginger, onion and mushrooms with the garlic and chilies for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the shrimp with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Scatter with coriander if you have it.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Garlic Pepper Shrimp
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and the white pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque all the way through. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and chilies for 1 minute, then the garlic for 1 minute, then add the oyster sauce, fish sauce, sugar and 4 tbsp water.
Return the shrimp with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the glossy garlic sauce over.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Black Bean Shrimp Stir-Fry
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
For the sauce, stir together the black bean sauce, soy sauce, sugar and 4 tbsp water.
Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the shrimp in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until pink and opaque all the way through; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the pepper and onion with the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the shrimp with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Scatter with the green spring onions.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Kung Pao Shrimp Stir-Fry
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
For the sauce, stir together the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, cornstarch and 3 tbsp water.
Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the shrimp in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until pink and opaque all the way through; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the dried chilies and Sichuan pepper for 30 seconds, then with the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the shrimp with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Toss in the peanuts and green spring onions.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Broccoli and Oyster Sauce Shrimp Stir-Fry
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
For the sauce, stir together the oyster sauce, soy sauce and 3 tbsp water.
Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the shrimp in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until pink and opaque all the way through; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the broccoli with 3 tbsp water (cover 2 minutes to steam) and with the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the shrimp with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Finish with the sesame oil.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Sweet and Sour Shrimp Stir-Fry
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
For the sauce, stir together the ketchup, vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, cornstarch and 4 tbsp water.
Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the shrimp in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until pink and opaque all the way through; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the pepper, onion and pineapple with the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the shrimp with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Toss until everything is coated in the bright sauce.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Ginger Scallion Shrimp
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and white pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque all the way through. Rest on a warm plate.

Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 1 minute, then the ginger and spring onions for 1 minute, then add the soy sauce, wine and 4 tbsp water.
Return the shrimp with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Drizzle with the sesame oil.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Sichuan Cumin Shrimp Stir-Fry
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
For the sauce, stir together the soy sauce and 2 tbsp water.
Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the shrimp in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until pink and opaque all the way through; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the cumin, chili flakes and onion with the garlic and ginger for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the shrimp with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Toss in the coriander.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Sichuan Dry-Fried Shrimp Stir-Fry
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
For the sauce, stir together the soy sauce and sugar.
Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the shrimp in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until pink and opaque all the way through; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the green beans for 5 minutes until blistered, then the chilies and Sichuan pepper, then with the garlic and ginger for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the shrimp with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Serve right away while the beans are crisp.

recipes.title: Sichuan Fish-Fragrant Shrimp Stir-Fry
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
For the sauce, stir together the chili bean paste, vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, cornstarch and 4 tbsp water.
Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the shrimp in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until pink and opaque all the way through; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the eggplant until soft, then with the garlic and ginger for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the shrimp with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Toss until glossy.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Sichuan Mala Shrimp
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and the ground Sichuan pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque all the way through. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the chili oil, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and 3 tbsp water.
Return the shrimp with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the numbing chili sauce over.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Ginger Shrimp Shogayaki
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
For the sauce, stir together the soy sauce, mirin, sake and grated ginger.
Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the shrimp in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until pink and opaque all the way through; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the onion with the garlic and ginger for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the shrimp with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Serve with the raw shredded cabbage.

recipes.title: Japanese Yakisoba Shrimp Noodles
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
For the sauce, stir together the Worcestershire sauce, oyster sauce and ketchup.
Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the shrimp in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until pink and opaque all the way through; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the cabbage and carrot, then the noodles with the garlic and ginger for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the shrimp with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Toss everything together until hot.
Serve with steamed short-grain rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Teriyaki Shrimp
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and a pinch of salt only (the sauce is salty).
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque all the way through. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the soy sauce, mirin, sake and sugar and let it bubble 2 minutes until syrupy.
Return the shrimp with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Turn to coat and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve with steamed short-grain rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Butter Ponzu Shrimp

ingredients.name: Ponzu (or soy sauce with lemon juice)

steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque all the way through. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the ponzu and butter and swirl until glossy.
Return the shrimp with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Scatter with the spring onions.
Serve with steamed short-grain rice.

recipes.title: Korean Bulgogi-Style Shrimp Stir-Fry
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
For the sauce, stir together the soy sauce, sugar, grated pear and sesame oil.
Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the shrimp in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until pink and opaque all the way through; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the onion with the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the shrimp with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and the green spring onions.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Korean Spicy Gochujang Shrimp Stir-Fry
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
For the sauce, stir together the gochujang, chili flakes, soy sauce, sugar and sesame oil.
Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the shrimp in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until pink and opaque all the way through; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the onion and cabbage with the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the shrimp with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Scatter with the green spring onions.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Korean Japchae Shrimp Noodles
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
For the sauce, stir together the soy sauce, sugar and sesame oil.
Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the shrimp in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until pink and opaque all the way through; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the carrot and mushrooms, then the spinach, then the cooked noodles with the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the shrimp with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Toss well and serve warm or at room temperature.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Korean Soy Garlic Shrimp
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque all the way through. Rest on a warm plate.

Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 1 minute, then the garlic for 1 minute, then add the soy sauce, honey, vinegar and chili flakes and bubble until sticky.
Return the shrimp with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Turn to coat.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Lemongrass Shrimp Stir-Fry
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
For the sauce, stir together the fish sauce, sugar and 2 tbsp water.
Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the shrimp in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until pink and opaque all the way through; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the lemongrass, chili and onion with the garlic and shallots for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the shrimp with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Top with the coriander.
Serve with rice or rice noodles with herbs.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Shaking Shrimp Bo Luc Lac-Style
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
For the sauce, stir together the oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce and sugar.
Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the shrimp in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until pink and opaque all the way through; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the onion with the garlic and shallots for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the shrimp with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Serve on the watercress and tomatoes.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Nuoc Cham Shrimp
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque all the way through. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and shallots for 1 minute, then the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the fish sauce, sugar, lime juice, chili and 3 tbsp water.
Return the shrimp with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon over and scatter with mint.
Serve with rice or rice noodles with herbs.

recipes.title: Indian Masala Shrimp
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and the garam masala, turmeric and chili.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque all the way through. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onions, garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the onions, garlic and ginger for 5 minutes, then the tomatoes and 4 tbsp water until jammy.
Return the shrimp with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Scatter with coriander.
Serve with basmati rice or naan.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Devilled Shrimp
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and the chili flakes.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque all the way through. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion, garlic, ginger and curry leaves for 1 minute, then the onion and pepper for 3 minutes, then the ketchup, chili sauce, soy sauce and 3 tbsp water.
Return the shrimp with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Toss to coat.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Indonesian Kecap Manis Shrimp Stir-Fry
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
For the sauce, stir together the kecap manis, soy sauce and 2 tbsp water.
Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the shrimp in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until pink and opaque all the way through; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the green beans and pepper with the shallots, garlic and chilies for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the shrimp with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Toss until sticky.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Malaysian Sambal Shrimp Stir-Fry
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
For the sauce, stir together the sambal, tamarind and sugar with 3 tbsp water.
Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the shrimp in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until pink and opaque all the way through; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the onion and beans with the shallots, garlic and ginger for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the shrimp with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Toss until coated.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Filipino Bistek-Style Shrimp
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque all the way through. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the onion rings for 3 minutes, then the soy sauce, lemon juice and 4 tbsp water.
Return the shrimp with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the onions and sauce over.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Mexican Fajita Shrimp
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and the chili powder, cumin and paprika.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque all the way through. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the peppers and onion until charred at the edges, then a splash of water.
Return the shrimp with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Slice the meat, squeeze over the lime and pile into tortillas.
Serve with warm tortillas and rice.

recipes.title: Mexican Mole-Style Shrimp
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and ground cumin.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque all the way through. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the mole paste and stock and simmer until thick, then melt in the chocolate.
Return the shrimp with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the sauce over and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve with warm tortillas and rice.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Queso Shrimp
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and the chili powder.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque all the way through. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the jalapeño, then the milk and cornstarch until thick; melt in the cheese off the heat.
Return the shrimp with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Pour the queso over.
Serve with rice and beans.

recipes.title: Jamaican Escovitch Shrimp

ingredients.name: Red bell pepper, cut into thin strips

steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and the allspice.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque all the way through. Rest on a warm plate.

Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion, garlic, spring onions and scotch bonnet for 1 minute, then the onion, carrot, pepper and scotch bonnet for 2 minutes, then the vinegar and sugar for 1 minute.
Return the shrimp with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Pour the hot pickled vegetables over.
Serve with rice and peas.

recipes.title: Cuban Mojo Shrimp
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and the cumin and oregano.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque all the way through. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion, pepper and garlic for 1 minute, then the garlic for 1 minute, then the citrus juice; bubble 2 minutes.
Return the shrimp with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the garlicky mojo over.
Serve with white rice and black beans.

recipes.title: Peruvian Saltado Shrimp Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: Green chili (aji amarillo if you can find it)

steps: Pat the shrimp dry and toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
For the sauce, stir together the soy sauce and vinegar with the tomatoes.
Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the shrimp in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until pink and opaque all the way through; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the onion wedges and chili with the onion and garlic for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the shrimp with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Toss with the hot fries.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Brazilian Acebolado Shrimp
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and the paprika.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque all the way through. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the onion rings in the butter until soft and golden, then the vinegar.
Return the shrimp with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Pile the onions on top.
Serve with rice and black beans.

recipes.title: Argentine Salsa Criolla Shrimp
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque all the way through. Rest on a warm plate.
Meanwhile, off the heat, mix the onion, pepper, tomatoes, vinegar and oil for the salsa while the meat rests.
Spoon the salsa over.
Serve with roast potatoes or a green salad.

recipes.title: Italian Piccata Shrimp
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and black pepper; dust lightly with flour.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque all the way through. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the stock, lemon juice and capers and bubble 2 minutes, then swirl in the butter.
Return the shrimp with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Scatter with parsley.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Marsala Shrimp
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and black pepper; dust lightly with flour.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque all the way through. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the mushrooms in the butter until golden, then the Marsala and stock and reduce by half.
Return the shrimp with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the mushrooms and sauce over.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Saltimbocca-Style Shrimp
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and black pepper; lay a sage leaf and a slice of prosciutto on each piece and press.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque all the way through. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the wine and butter and bubble 1 minute.
Return the shrimp with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the buttery sauce over.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: French Au Poivre Shrimp
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and the crushed peppercorns, pressed on both sides.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque all the way through. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the shallots and garlic for 1 minute, then the brandy (careful, it can flame), then the cream; bubble 2 minutes.
Return the shrimp with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the peppery cream over.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: French Dijon Cream Shrimp
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque all the way through. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the shallots and garlic for 1 minute, then the wine and reduce by half, then the cream and mustard.
Return the shrimp with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Stir in the tarragon and spoon over.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: French Beurre Blanc Shrimp
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and white pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque all the way through. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the shallots and garlic for 1 minute, then the wine and vinegar until almost gone, then whisk in the butter a cube at a time off the heat.
Return the shrimp with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the sauce over and scatter with chives.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

recipes.title: Spanish Al Ajillo Shrimp
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque all the way through. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the sliced garlic and chili gently until golden, then the wine.
Return the shrimp with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Scatter with parsley and serve with bread.
Serve with crusty bread or potatoes.

recipes.title: Portuguese Garlic Wine Shrimp Bitoque-Style
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque all the way through. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the garlic and bay leaves, then the wine; bubble 2 minutes.
Return the shrimp with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Serve each portion topped with a fried egg.

recipes.title: Greek Feta and Tomato Shrimp
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and the oregano.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque all the way through. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the cherry tomatoes until they burst, then the olives.
Return the shrimp with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Crumble over the feta.
Serve with rice, potatoes or warm pitta.

recipes.title: American Honey Garlic Shrimp
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque all the way through. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the garlic for 30 seconds, then the honey, soy sauce and vinegar; bubble until sticky.
Return the shrimp with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Turn to coat.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: American Creamy Tuscan-Style Shrimp
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and the Italian seasoning.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque all the way through. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the sun-dried tomatoes and garlic, then the cream and parmesan, then the spinach until wilted.
Return the shrimp with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon over.
Serve with mashed potatoes, corn or a green salad.

recipes.title: British Peppercorn Shrimp
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and the crushed peppercorns.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque all the way through. Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the cream and mustard; bubble 2 minutes.
Return the shrimp with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon over and serve with chips or salad.
Serve with mashed potatoes and greens.
